name: Drawquarium
lang: English, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Russian
short: Draw your very own fish and build a cozy little aquarium. And if you like, set it as your animated desktop wallpaper! Watch your drawings come to life. Feed them, raise them and collect golden scales to unlock new decorations. There's also some handy tools to help you focus and unwind.
about: Hi, I'm Kaleb! I work as a 3D artist in the film industry, but my heart kept pulling me toward a small, very personal game idea. One of the reasons I started developing this game was that I wanted to bring my children’s drawings to life 💖.      Drawquarium is a relaxing aquarium sandbox where your drawings come to life!  Draw your own fish and plants, feed them, raise them, and collect golden fish scales to unlock new decorations and tools. Create your own cozy little underwater world and bring it to your desktop as an animated wallpaper!     And don't worry, you don't have to be an artist to create something beautiful! You can always choose from a variety of ready-made fish and simply enjoy watching your little aquarium come to life.              Draw Your Own Fish COMPANIONS   Draw anything you want and watch your creations come to life inside your aquarium. Start with simple shapes, use templates for a little inspiration, or get as creative as you like. There are no rules, just you and your imagination!            When you place new creatures in your fish tank, they will interact with the others, forming friendships, rivalries and even relationships. They can become enemies and quibble or find their soulmate and have cute little babies 🥰.               Decorate With Your Own Plants   Any decent aquarium will need an abundance of thriving plants. Create the perfect habitat by drawing your own vegetation and placing it wherever you want. Of course, if you’d rather be drawing sea mines or skyscrapers… Who are we to stop you?          Wallpaper mode!  Miss your babies whenever you go and close the game? Simply turn on the Desktop Wallpaper Mode and all of your creations will stay right there with you. Whether you’re crunching numbers for the boss or browsing a forum, you can observe, feed and play with your fish right there on your desktop.           Unlock Limitless Customization   Change the way the sand looks, customize the lighting, and place decorative rocks, driftwood and more. Your aquarium is a tiny living world, filled with creatures made and cared for by you.            Your Cozy Little Space to Focus & Unwind   Journal your thoughts, organize your day with a task manager, or use the timer to stay focused. Customize your clock and set your aquarium as an animated desktop wallpaper, so your little fish friends can keep you company while you work, study, or simply unwind.           Upload Your Own Drawings   Upload any PNG image and watch it become part of your aquarium! Whether it's your kid's latest masterpiece or something you created yourself.             Visit anytime     for a gentle, mindful break     ♥

name: Birdwatching Notebook
lang: English*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*, French*, Japanese*, Korean*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Russian**
short: Turn your desktop into your very own birdwatching spot, and await the arrival of new avian friends! Enjoy a cozy idle game — place a tiny postcard on the corner of your screen, keeping you company with pleasant scenes and visiting birds. Oh, and don't forget your camera!
about: Birders, assemble!    We've developed a cozy idle game just for you. Now, you can enjoy birdwatching from the comfort of your desktop, too!     Place your postcard — a window to another world — right at the corner of your screen.    Decorate your favourite birding spot to your heart's content. If a bird happens to fancy your humble abode, it just might stop by for a visit!      Join us on Discord!        Unlock a variety of birding spots! The docks, beaches, deserts, even rainforests…  Each place has its own unique scenery, and new bird species to discover!             Your Birding Area can be freely manipulated!   Zoom, move, and arrange your favourite birding spot however you like   — the birds will keep you company while you work.                  The Blueprint System is now live!  You can save your builds, share them, and quickly switch between different designs!       Sparrows aren't the only birds that want to hang out.   There are dozens of other bird species, too!   They have their own preferred times to visit — maybe you can capture something wonderful!          The more a bird visits, the more comfortable they'll feel!   You might be able to discover new behaviors over time…           Snap! Immortalize your favourite moments with your camera.   Once you've documented every unique behavior from a bird, you'll earn a statue of them!                   Any new lifers today?  Your handbook also keeps a record of Birding Areas, decoration, photographs, achievements, and more!            If you enlarge the main illustration, you'll be able to discover just what traits make that bird special!           You can change the time of day and weather of your Birding Area as you desire.   Regardless of time, or weather, you'll meet a new friend who enjoys it, that's for sure!      In the night, nocturnal birds await…             Join your friends for a birdwatching session!   Transform into a little bird and land in your friends’ birdwatching spots, leaving behind emotes, photos, and little gifts as keepsakes.          You can also request and collect blueprints of other players’ birdwatching spots, bringing your favorite layout inspirations back to your own Birdland.      Your bird friends will bring all sorts of trinkets for you to collect!   They'll drop all sorts of colorful feathers, and maybe more…             Boss Crow loves anything that sparkles — whether it be shimmering feathers, or the bright glint of bottle caps!   He'll return the favor in Crow Coins!           More features are under development:     you'll be able to share gorgeous birding spots with your friends, and more…

lang: English, French, German, Russian, Vietnamese, Spanish - Latin America, Ukrainian, Indonesian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Thai, Turkish, Portuguese - Brazil, Polish, Korean, Italian, Spanish - Spain
short: A desktop idle RPG where monsters battle on their own while you work or study! Recruit a colorful cast of monsters, build your own squad, and reclaim the Dungeon Cores stolen by humans.
about: Even while you're busy working or studying, your monsters' adventure never stops.  Build your own squad, combine skills and equipment, and reclaim the Dungeon Cores stolen by humans!           Keep the game running in the corner of your screen while you work, study, or watch videos.    Your monster squad will automatically battle humans and collect chests.  Need more screen space? Simply minimize the game into Icon Mode.    Enjoy this free-to-play desktop idle RPG and add a little adventure to your everyday routine!                     On every third attack, when an enemy is defeated, or when a target is marked.  Each skill activates automatically when its specific conditions are met.    Choose which of each character's 8 unique skills to equip and experiment with different combinations.  The skills you pair together can completely change how your squad fights!                     Your monsters keep fighting and collecting chests even while you're focused on other things.  Open chests to discover new equipment and make your monster squad even stronger.    Condense unwanted equipment and use the materials you've gathered to craft new gear.  Who knows? Your next chest might contain that legendary piece of equipment you've been waiting for!                     Equipment of Legendary rarity or higher can be transferred to your Steam Inventory.  Trade the equipment you've earned with other players through the Steam Community Market!                     Humans have stolen nearly every Dungeon Core, leaving only one remaining.  While the legion fights to protect the last Core, a band of monsters deemed unworthy of joining its ranks sets out to reclaim those that were lost.           A former Labyrinth Lord and a one-armed sharpshooter.  A cowardly lich and a staff with an insatiable appetite.  A sorrowful jester and a Grim Reaper who protects fellow monsters.  Gather these unlikely heroes, each with their own story to tell, and form your own expedition squad.    From medieval knights to the armies of a desert pharaoh, new human forces stand in your way with every chapter.    Join the Monsters on Their Twilight Expedition!

name: Coin Harvest
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Arabic
short: Robotic arms sweep a steady pour of coins off your plateau. Unlock islands, conquer six realms and ascend for crystals in an idle game that sits on your desktop while you work or play.
about: Coins pour from a pipe and pile up on your plateau. Robotic arms swing through the heap and sweep them over the edge into their chutes, and every coin that falls in pays. That's the loop. Now make it bigger.  Click Pour to drop more coins, or unlock Auto Flow and let the pipe run on its own. Click fast and a boost multiplier builds up. Unlock up to six islands in each realm, each with its own arm, and upgrade each arm's speed, size, magnetism, lucky drops and critical hits. Bronze coins give way to silver, gold, platinum, diamond, emerald and ruby, each worth more than the last.                Six realms stand between you and the top, from Brass to Frost. Every realm has its own coins and islands, plus a rule that changes how it plays. Heavy Coins pour slowly but pay more, Sparkling Crits land often and hit hard, and Frozen Time makes boosts last longer. Move coins between realms at the Exchange. The realms you leave behind keep earning a share while you play another.  When a realm has earned enough, ascend. It starts over, pays out crystals and opens the next realm. Crystals go to the Crystal Shop: permanent upgrades that survive every ascension (more income, free islands, cheaper exchanges, the Auto-Pour ability) and one-off boosts like Gold Rush and Time Warp.  The whole thing runs as a small transparent widget on your desktop. Drag it wherever it fits and keep it on top if you like. It keeps earning while you work or play, and you can switch to fullscreen at any time.

name: Desktop Raid
lang: Simplified Chinese, English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Thai, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America
short: Assemble your adventure squad on the desktop! Classic RPG meets idle play—no grind, no stress, just nonstop progress. Your heroes fight, level up, and loot while you work or study. Explore rich classes, powerful skills, and thrilling gear drops. RPG excitement, anytime, anywhere!
about: 【Bug Fix in Progress】        Set it in the corner of your desktop, and your heroes will continuously battle monsters and find treasure, whether you're working or slacking off! No manual control is needed and interruptions are no issue. The fully automated combat offers a completely relaxing leveling experience. Say goodbye to the fatigue of traditional RPGs with njihovim repetitive map runs, mob grinding, and skill clicking. Simply open the game anytime to harvest your loot, power up, and advance to new dungeons, effortlessly enjoying the thrill of soaring power levels!               This is an idle RPG you can really get hooked on—the monsters get stronger on their own, so the grinding never stops! Automated combat plows through everything from trash mobs to bosses, with gear dropping and stats rising constantly, perfectly recreating the satisfying loot loop of RPG dungeons. Slay, loot, and enhance, with the added thrill of random affixes and set effects. You can chase the ultimate god-tier gear, all while idling!                       The game features over a dozen branching classes, from Warrior and Mage to Assassin, Summoner, Tomb Keeper, and Alchemist. Each hero possesses unique talents and growth paths! The number of skills is staggering, allowing for countless combat styles. You can build a screen-clearing AOE burst team, or a complex tactical squad combining summoning, control, and damage-over-time effects. Freely mix and match builds to create your ultimate dungeon-clearing party!               With its retro pixel art side-scrolling style, the game pays homage to the thrilling combat of classic RPGs! It sits neatly in a corner of your screen, taking up minimal space and not interfering with your work or studies. But a quick glance is all it takes to see your adventure squad in the heat of battle! Beneath its casual idle exterior lies a deep RPG progression system. Looting while idling and the satisfying pace of leveling up make for an exhilarating experience that’s sure to boost your mood, even if you’re just checking in during a break.               The combat unfolds in a side-scrolling auto-chess format. While the battles are fully automated, every lineup decision is packed with strategic depth! Frontline tanks, backline damage dealers, crowd control combos, main and sub-DPS synergy... with dozens of skills combining in random ways, you can unleash devastating damage combos or intricate control chains. Pulling off an upset with a weaker team or turning the tide with a single brilliant move all comes down to your understanding and strategic deployment of heroes!

name: SUSHI PARADE Demo
lang: English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
short: The demo of a conveyor belt sushi shop on your desktop. Plates pass in front of your windows, and clicks off the lane go through to your apps. Chefs make sushi, customers eat it, and coins come in. Fill a Sushi Dex of about 80 entries and lay out the lane your way.
about: A conveyor belt sushi shop on your desktop  SUSHI PARADE runs in a transparent window laid over your desktop, so the lane and its plates pass in front of whatever you have open. The game only takes clicks on its own parts: the lane, the characters, and any open menu. Click anywhere else and it goes straight to the app behind.  Want it out of the way? Run a single lane along one edge of the screen, or turn off Always on Top and let your other windows cover it.          A small shop that keeps itself busy  Chefs make sushi and send it down the lane. Customers come by, each with their own tastes, budget, and appetite, eat what they like, and pay in coins. You can click a plate to eat it yourself or carry it to someone. There is no way to fail.  When you feel like doing more:   Orders: accept the ticket above a customer's head and the chef makes that sushi first. Filling it pays extra coins and EXP.  Hand swap: as the game goes on, you can right-click the lane to change hands. Glutton vacuums up nearby plates, and Serving Hand sends a plate to a customer.  Time away: sales from up to 8 hours are waiting when you next open the game.   Small things happen, too. Empty plates pile up on the rack. A plate nobody eats grows wings and a halo and floats away. And Shari Ryman, who left a trading company to open this shop, sometimes murmurs, "…I still can't throw out my business cards."       About 80 entries to collect  The demo's Sushi Dex holds about 80 entries: sushi from Tuna (Lean) to Snow Crab, plus sides such as tea, juice, and sweets. Each entry comes with its own description and a comment from Shari.  New sushi opens up in Neta Dev ("neta" means the topping). Eat enough of one kind, save up coins, and the next comes within reach. Rarely, a plate comes by as Shiny and sells for more.       Make the lane your own  About 20 lane shapes unlock as the shop grows: one line along the bottom, an L, a small ring in the corner, a route through all four corners, and shapes with warps built in. Lane Skins such as Hinoki Flow and Choo-Choo Railway change the look. Invisible draws no belt at all, leaving only the plates moving across your desktop.  As the game goes on, Lane Craft lets you draw your own on a grid. The demo limits how many custom lanes you can keep. Each new lane uses a Craft Hammer: you get some when Lane Craft opens and more each day, and hammers can't be bought. You also get Glitch and Edge Warp parts, which send plates from one stretch to another on a Fixed layout. A Fixed layout works only at the screen size it was made on.       As the shop grows, you can also place furniture around the lane, such as a Noren Curtain, Red Lantern, Goldfish Bowl, or Cat on a Cushion, and a food sample of any sushi you have eaten many times.  Streaming and videos are welcome  Feel free to stream SUSHI PARADE or post videos of it. Monetization is fine, and there is no need to ask for permission. It also works nicely left running in the corner of a work-along or chatting stream. If you capture a window, turn on Streamer Mode in Settings to show the game as a normal window with a background.  Technical notes  SUSHI PARADE has no servers or accounts of its own and sends no analytics. It goes online only through the Steam client, for Steam Cloud saves and Steam's server clock (used for daily bonuses and limited-time events). Buttons that lead outside the game, such as the demo survey, open in your browser only when you press them. To tell whether a click should land on the game, it reads the cursor position; it does not monitor your keyboard.  Because the game layers a transparent window over your desktop, a small number of antivirus programs may warn about it on first launch. Overlays may also conflict with the anti-cheat software used by some online games, such as Vanguard or EasyAntiCheat, so we recommend quitting SUSHI PARADE before playing them. On macOS, Screen Recording permission is requested only if you use the Desktop

As you progress and unlock speed boosts, check-ins happen more frequently, but you're always in control of when you engage.  The core loop is brief interactions with individual plants - stage transitions, environmental adjustments, and optional encounter minigames. Want more engagement? The clubhouse offers games, challenges to strategise around, orders to fulfill, and grow houses to customise. Want less? Just tend your plants and ignore the extras. about: Spend Every Day on Your PC Together.   Desktop Muse is more than just a character on your desktop. She notices what you're doing and responds to your daily PC activities with different animations. She can also understand what you say, check your schedule, and help with supported everyday computer tasks.  A desktop companion that's truly there with you while you use your PC.            Alive on Your Desktop   Desktop Muse currently features  more than 50 animations , with multiple variations for certain situations.  Ren responds in her own way depending on what you're doing. For example:  When you play a game, she gets into gaming mode too.            When you watch a video, she'll stay by your side and watch along.            When a download finishes, she'll let you know right away.            If you have unread messages, she'll remind you not to forget about them.          You don't need to constantly interact with her.   Just use your PC as usual, and you'll gradually discover more sides of her.      She Understands What You Want to Do           After connecting a supported desktop AI tool, you can communicate directly with Ren through  text or voice .  She can check your Google Calendar and remind you about upcoming events, look up the weather, help draft messages, play music, and perform supported computer actions.  *You can connect Google Calendar from Settings. Right-click the Desktop Muse icon in the system tray and select  Settings . On the Settings page, select  Calendar , then choose the Google account you want to connect.  PC control features such as opening and moving windows have also been made more stable. When you launch a Steam game, Ren will also enter the corresponding  Game Mode .  Currently supported:   OpenAI Codex / Anthropic Claude Code / Doubao / DeepSeek   *Because the Agent features of  Doubao  and  DeepSeek  are not yet fully available, Ren may behave inconsistently when connected to either service. These features are still being actively improved, and there is plenty of room for further refinement. We’ll continue improving their stability and usefulness based on real-world usage.    Desktop Muse will continue to add more animations, interactions, and useful Companion features.   Not just staying on your desktop.   Using your PC together with you.   Desktop Muse — Your Desktop Companion    AI Companion Setup     Install and sign in to a supported desktop AI tool, such as  OpenAI Codex, Anthropic Claude Code, Doubao, or DeepSeek .    Launch  Desktop Muse .    Go to  Settings → Advanced → Voice Assistant  and turn it on.    You can type to Ren, or press  Ctrl + Alt + Space  / click the microphone button next to the character to use voice input.    To let Ren perform supported computer actions, enable  Local Desktop Control .    Voice output uses  Windows TTS  by default. To use ElevenLabs or OpenAI TTS, enter your own API Key and configure the corresponding voice settings.

about: 3D Printer Manager   is a strategic semi idle management game that takes you into the addictive world of 3D printing. Start your journey as a hobbyist in your bedroom with a single, noisy printer and a dream. Your goal? To build the ultimate 3D printing empire.  Manage your fleet of machines, optimize your filament supply, and fulfill customer orders to fund your expansion. As you grow, you'll move from a cramped bedroom to a garage, an office, and finally a   factory. Whether you're a 3D printing enthusiast or a fan of tycoon games, 3D Printer Manager offers a satisfying blend of strategy, progression, and idle mechanics.        Build Your Fleet:  Purchase and manage distinct printer types including reliable  Cartesian  workhorses, lightning-fast  CoreXY  machines, and tall  Delta  towers. Each comes with its own speed, cost, and reliability trade-offs.     Master Materials:  Work your way up from basic PLA to advanced materials like ABS, TPU, Nylon, and premium Carbon Fiber. Each filament type commands a different market price and requires careful management.     Deep Upgrade System:  Fine-tune your machines for peak performance. Install Klipper firmware to boost speed, improve durability to reduce breakdowns, and upgrade efficiency to cut material costs.     Expand Your Empire:  Outgrow your space? Move your operation from a humble Bedroom with 4 spaces for printers, to a Garage, Office, and eventually a high-tech Factory capable of housing dozens of machines.     Automate & Optimize:  You can't click forever. Hire staff to keep your farm running 24/7. They'll handle print jobs, perform repairs, and prioritize high-value orders while you sit back and watch the profits roll in.     Fulfill Orders:  Take on contracts for specific prints, from the classic "Benchy" to complex "Articulated Dragons." Balancing bulk orders with daily production is key to maximizing your reputation and income.

about: PC moments become little creatures  Tab-lings is a desktop companion game where optional, selected parts of your PC activity can create named creatures that live just above the Windows taskbar. Choose sources such as foreground window and browser titles or filenames from folders you select. You can also create every creature manually and play offline. Your Tab-lings wander, play, sleep, and socialize while you work, browse, or use other applications, without needing constant clicks or attention.  Care for a growing collection  Feed your Tab-lings, customize them, learn their traits, and help their relationships grow. Complete daily, weekly, monthly, and lifetime goals to earn rewards at your own pace. Draw a custom 16 x 16 creature and give it a full set of animated poses.  Make the habitat yours  Choose how many Tab-lings live above the taskbar, decide how the roster rotates, and arrange habitats across your displays. Empty habitat space lets clicks pass through to the applications underneath, while each visible creature remains ready for a visit.  Private and local by default  Every automatic discovery source starts off and has its own visible control. Candidate text passes through a local privacy gate before it can affect gameplay or be saved. Rejected text is not stored. Pause discovery immediately, inspect or clear local history, and remove saved game data whenever you want.  The game does not capture screenshots, pixels, keystrokes, password contents, or accessibility-tree text. Notification-sender discovery is unavailable in the Steam edition. The rest of the local game works offline without an account.

about: Chestnut's Idle Farm is a pixel-art desktop idle management game. Grow vegetables, plant trees, and go fishing with Chestnut the cat. Take your harvest to market, then cook up a few dishes for the little animals stopping by for a meal. Keep the farm in a corner of your desktop while you work or study, and check in during a break to see what's ready to harvest—and whether Chestnut has secretly fallen asleep.       Go about your day—Chestnut has plans of his own. When there's work to do, he'll help tend the fields; when things are quiet, he'll curl up for a nap. Focus on your own tasks, then check on the farm and top up supplies when you have a moment. Let this little farm keep you company as you build it up at your own pace.         From a tiny sprout beneath the soil to acres of fields and a bountiful harvest, you've already come a long way. Now it's time to explore life on your very own farm. Buy plots, choose seeds, grow different vegetables and grains, and plant a few fruit trees nearby. Tend your crops yourself, or let Chestnut help with watering and harvesting. As your farming level rises, you can unlock automatic sowing so he can take on a little more of the fieldwork.  Try new crops and watch your fruit trees bear harvest after harvest. Sell what you grow or set ingredients aside for your recipes—the choice is yours.               Add bait to your fishing rod, cast your line, and wait for a bite.          Put the produce you want to sell on display, and little animals will arrive by boat to shop. Watch them dock, come ashore, pick up their purchases, and sail away with their goods as your little harbor comes to life.                  Browse your recipes, gather the ingredients you need, and turn your harvest into tasty dishes. Make a single serving or prepare several at once—the delicious aromas will soon draw in your animal guests.  Watch your guests enjoy their meals and your restaurant earn its keep. short: In an age where AI is getting better at pretending to understand you, let a little digital plant that never lies say what you truly want to hear. Watch it gently sway in the breeze, customize its speech bubbles, or import vocabulary lists, lyrics, and more.
about: About This Game  It sits quietly in the corner of your desktop, occasionally popping up with a message.  Sometimes, it's a motivational quote:  "You've got this today."  "You don't have to become amazing all at once. Just moving a little forward today is enough."  "Not seeing results now doesn't mean your efforts aren't happening."  Sometimes, it's a reminder:  "3:00 PM, submit assignment."  "8:00 PM, review vocabulary."  "Get the package when you get home tonight."  "Stand up and stretch, drink some water."  You can write all of this yourself and set the times.  So it can be your desktop motivational buddy, or a handy reminder assistant.  Of course, you can also use it to — memorize vocabulary.  Put in SAT, GRE, IELTS, or TOEFL words, or any words you want to remember:  persist — to keep going  opportunity — a chance  improve — to get better  achieve — to reach a goal  When you're tired of studying, look up and memorize one.  If you have a lot of words or sentences, you can directly import a TXT file.  This is "Digital Green Plant." In the age of AI, it won't offer hollow pleasantries. Instead, it will accompany you with the voice inside your heart through your toughest times.  When you're tired, it gives you a word of encouragement.  When you're afraid of forgetting things, it gives you a nudge.  When you want to study, it memorizes a few words with you.  How to Use    Hold the left mouse button and drag the plant to move it.    Right-click the plant to open the settings panel.    Use the settings panel to edit or import speech bubble messages, adjust reminder intervals, set a daily alarm, change the language, and configure screensaver mode.    Click “Save Settings” to apply your changes.    Use the “—” and “×” buttons beside the plant to minimize or exit the application.    Virtual Plant does not demand constant attention or ask you to complete complicated daily tasks. It simply stays alive in a corner of your screen and speaks the words you have chosen when the time is right.  It does not pretend to have feelings, and it does not pretend to understand you better than you understand yourself.  You choose the words. It quietly says them back to you.

It opens there automatically in a borderless, always-on-top window, so you can keep an eye on the fleet while you work, watch something or play another game. name: Desktop Tiny Tides
lang: English**
short: Turn your desktop into a living fishing world. Drag your boat across the screen, discover 144 different fish, cast your line wherever they swim, complete timing-based fishing, upgrade your equipment, and build your collection.
about: About This Game  Desktop Tiny Tides is a relaxing desktop fishing game that transforms your computer screen into an active aquatic world.  Fish swim freely across your desktop while you control a small fishing boat by dragging it wherever you want to go. Follow schools of fish, search for rare species, cast your line, and complete a timing-based fishing minigame to secure your catch.  The game runs directly on your desktop, allowing fish and your boat to travel across multiple monitors. You can keep the game open while doing other things or focus entirely on finding every species.  A Living Desktop Ecosystem  The fish are more than simple collectibles. They move around the desktop, form schools, avoid obstacles, react to your boat, flee from danger, and interact with other fish.  Some fish stay close to the bottom of the screen, while others travel in groups or hide near desktop icons. Larger predators may hunt smaller fish, and nearby fish can become frightened and escape.  Every fish has its own behavior, preferred time of day, size range, weight, and rarity.  144 Different Fish  Discover 144 different fish species ranging from common everyday catches to extremely rare mythical discoveries.  Fish can appear in several rarity levels:    Common    Uncommon    Rare    Epic    Legendary    Mythic    Each fish also has a randomly determined size and weight. Larger catches are physically bigger, more valuable, and harder to overlook as they swim across your desktop.  Your collection records every species you have caught. Undiscovered fish remain hidden as silhouettes until you successfully catch them.  Fish at Different Times of Day  Different species appear during different parts of the day.  The game uses your computer’s local time to determine whether it is morning, afternoon, evening, or night. Some fish may only appear during a specific period, encouraging you to return at different times to complete your collection.  Timing-Based Fishing  Casting is controlled by holding and releasing the mouse button. The longer you charge the cast, the farther your bobber travels.  Once a fish bites, a timing-based fishing minigame begins. Stop the rotating indicator inside the success zone to reel the fish closer. More valuable fish require greater precision and may need several successful rounds before they can be caught.  Fish rarity affects the difficulty, while equipped fishing equipment can improve your chances.  Upgrade Your Fishing Equipment  Earn coins from your catches and spend them on new equipment.  Fishing Rods  Better rods increase the size of the minigame success zone, making difficult fish easier to catch.  Bobbers  Improved bobbers increase your maximum casting distance, allowing you to reach fish farther away from your boat.  Lures  Lures reduce the number of successful minigame stages required to catch a fish. Powerful lures can instantly catch fish that would normally require several rounds.  Fishing Traps  Place draggable fishing traps around your desktop. When a fish swims into an active trap, it has a chance to be caught automatically. Different traps provide different catch probabilities.  Purchased equipment can be equipped directly through the shop and visually changes parts of your fishing setup.  Explore Your Entire Desktop  Your boat is not restricted to a traditional body of water. Drag it freely across the desktop and between connected monitors.  Fish can appear from every direction and continue swimming throughout the available desktop space. Move your boat closer to interesting fish, but approach carefully, as they may notice you and flee.  Key Features    144 different fish species    Six fish rarity levels    Random fish sizes and weights    Fish schools and predator behavior    Species that appear at different times of day    Real-time clock-based spawning    Timing-based fishing minigame    Chargeable casting system    Upgradeable rods, bobbers, lures, and fishing traps    Draggable boat controls    M

name: My First Beehive
lang: English**
short: A slow, painted beekeeping game for the corner of your screen. Keep one hive of honeybees through a real year: watch the comb fill, find the queen, sell the honey, and spend it on the garden they fly out to. Nothing dies. It just keeps going while you work.
about: A hive on your desk, painted in acrylic My First Beehive is an idle beekeeping game built to sit beside your work. One glass-fronted observation hive, three frames of comb, and a garden out the back door. You look in when you like. The bees get on with it either way. A real year, at a gentle pace The colony follows the seasons of a Northern Virginia garden. A season is a week of your time. In spring the queen fills the comb with brood and the first honey arches over the top; in summer the foragers work the tulip poplar and the wildflowers; in fall the goldenrod comes in and the cluster draws together for winter. Leave for a fortnight and come back to the fortnight you missed, written in the journal. Everything on the comb is a bee doing something Watch a worker chew her way out of her cell and walk off pale. Find the queen - she is half again as long as the others, and she keeps to the brood. Put the magnifying glass on any cell and it tells you what is in it: an egg, a larva, capped honey, packed pollen. Foragers come home through the tube with pollen on their legs, the colour of whatever is flowering. Keep them, or just watch There are only a few things to do, and none of them is a chore. Harvest when there is honey to spare. Feed them if the stores run low. Treat for mites in the fall. Skip all of it and the hive is still there next spring, a little smaller. Nothing dies - a season you sit out costs you honey, and never the colony. Sell the honey. Spend it on the garden. Your honey is money. Every jar goes in the journal named for the flow it came from, and then you sell it and decide what it buys: another bed of flowers, the mite treatment that keeps the colony strong through the fall, or a tree - the expensive thing, bought perhaps once a year, that arrives as a sapling and takes seasons to fill out. And the garden pays you back. What is in bloom when the bees fly decides how much honey you get and what kind it is, so a bed planted this spring is next summer's harvest. A thin first year buys one more thing. A garden you have kept for years is a different hive altogether. A garden that moves Plant beds of coneflower, daisy, bee balm and black-eyed Susan, and the bees fly out to them. One breeze crosses the whole garden and every flower leans with it. Birds sing from the trees. It is always mid-afternoon. Where you put things is close to permanent, so the garden becomes a record of every choice you made. Painted, not rendered Every comb cell, every flower and every bee is a painting in acrylic, composited and moved by code. It looks like a picture because it is one. What is in the hive today   One observation hive, three frames, seen one at a time - lean in to the cells.   A real 364-day year at one season a week; it catches up on the time you were away.   The queen, the brood, the honey and the pollen, laid down the way a colony lays them.   A honey journal written in a real hand: a page a fortnight, every jar named for its flow.   Four things to do and no chores: harvest, feed, treat, check the stores. Skipping them costs honey, never the colony.   A real economy: sell your honey and spend it on flowers, on beekeeping supplies, and on trees that arrive as saplings and grow for years.   A garden that decides your harvest - what is flowering when the bees fly sets how much honey you get, and what kind.   Idle by design: it runs in a small window while you do something else.

about: TEKUTEKU: Discovery Notebook  A tiny traveler journeys along the bottom of your screen.  TEKUTEKU was born one night from a doodle, and travels the world out of curiosity. It finds the small things that catch the light, and keeps them.    I hope it feels a little like traveling alongside TEKUTEKU — gathering the stories of a town, finding some quiet while you work.         Wander and discover   TEKUTEKU takes its time among the alleys, signboards, cats, and tiny shrines. In a neighborhood that looks ordinary at first glance, something quietly sparkles — click it to tuck it into the notebook. These are things you only notice when you slow down and look closely; some reveal themselves only in the glow of sunset.          Record and slowly collect   Each discovery settles into a square of TEKUTEKU's notebook. As the light shifts through the day, the same alley shows a different face. And when TEKUTEKU moves on to another neighborhood, nothing is lost — the notebook, the people it met, and the keepsakes all travel with it.         Right there beside you   TEKUTEKU keeps you company without getting in the way, quietly going about its own little day. When you type, it scribbles along beside you — and on days you spend a little longer together, it might leave you a small letter. Keep it small in a corner, zoom in with the lens, or open it wide — choose how close you want to be.      Neighborhoods that are really there   Every place TEKUTEKU walks is a real one in Tokyo. I walked them myself, drew the buildings and alleys from what was there, and made the stories of each town. Travel with TEKUTEKU, and one day walk the real streets too.         Cute, warm, hand-drawn  Every alley, signboard and discovery is drawn by hand — by the illustrator who has been drawing TEKUTEKU for years in illustration, comics and stationery. No generative AI.               [Key Features]  - A little traveler who lives at the bottom of your screen  - Pack a lunchbox. name: Lunnitsa
lang: English*, Spanish - Latin America**
short: Lunnitsa is a 3D companion who lives on your desktop. She talks with you out loud, listens when you call her, looks at your screen if you let her and helps with tasks on your PC, always with your permission. You choose what she thinks with: the cloud or your own computer.
about: Lunnitsa doesn't live in a chat window. She lives on your desktop, standing on top of whatever you're doing, and she answers out loud. Say "Lunnitsa" and she's listening, or type if you'd rather. When you don't need her, she tucks away into a bubble and lets you work.   She actually helps.  She opens your programs, sets reminders, searches the web, reads the documents you drop on her and creates files. Before touching anything important she asks first, and you decide what she can and can't do.   She sees what you show her.  She can look at your screen, or at whatever's in front of your camera, when you ask. Turn it on, and she'll also glance at your screen on her own every now and then. The camera never turns on without your permission.   She's yours.  Pick one of four personalities, give her any name you like and tell her about yourself. Got your own VRM model? Load it. She remembers what matters, and forgets it with one click whenever you want. She speaks English and Spanish.   You choose what she thinks with.     In the cloud:  connect your account with an AI provider in a couple of clicks (or paste your key if you already have one). You can start without paying, using a free model the app picks for you; it has a daily usage limit. If you want more later, what you spend is between you and the provider.    On your PC:  download Local brain, a free DLC of about 19 GB, and the conversation is processed on your own computer. It needs a powerful PC, so check the requirements. If you ask her to search for something, that search does go online.    No surprises.  Her answers are AI-generated and can sometimes be wrong. With the local model she can't look at your screen when you ask. And no, she doesn't play chess.

about: Deskpot  is a miniature idle-farming simulator that accompanies you on your desktop! No infinite fields of crops. One potted plant at a time. Each time you press a key, a drop of water falls on your plant pot. You can place it wherever you like on your screen, and watch your plants grow as you click, type, and mash keys.  Grow and research plants  Unlock new plants as you progress through the game! If you harvest a plant enough times, you gain information about that plant in your Almanac. Each plant is different. Some take more watering to fully grow, but reward you with multiple drops or regrows.          Unlock cosmetics  Unlock different plant pots, faces and accessories through different requirements like 'amount of water drops created', 'amount of high quality plants harvested', 'amount of Almanac entries completed', and more! Upgrade your knowledge  Deskpot has  60 different plants , spread out over  five plant types :    Flowers    Vegetables    Fruit    Mushrooms    Foliage    Each plant type has its own upgrades you can buy on the ' Upgrades ' tab. Some raise the base price of a plant type, others make a plant type grow faster, or raise the odds of a multi-harvest.  There is also base upgrades, that affect all plants, or the entire experience. dev: 幻想叙事工作室Mirage Tales Studio
pub: 幻想叙事工作室Mirage Tales Studio
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Turkish, Norwegian, Japanese, Polish, Thai, Swedish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America, Korean
short: First, put a box on your computer desktop. Then wait, patiently. When the time comes, open it up and collect the cat that's grown inside. It really is that simple! Oh — and if you tuck a cat back into a box, it might just send a blessing your way.
about: I mean, do I really need to explain?  If you’ve spent any time around cats, you know the drill.   A delivery box you’ve just opened. A suitcase you haven’t even started packing…  Leave one sitting there for a little while, and what happens?  Well, would you look at that.   It’s grown a cat!       Your cat can settle into a tiny companion with a transparent background  quietly tucked away in a corner of your desktop.  Whether you’re working, studying, or sneaking in a little break  just glance over.   There it is.       Short-haired, long-haired, black, white, and every color in between…  Every cat has its own idea of what a cat should look like. Perfectly normal.  What’s that?   Some have nine tails? And others have tentacles?  Look, let’s not ask too many questions.  They’re just rare new breeds.   That’s all!       So of course, boxes aren’t the only things that can grow cats.  Washbasins, frying pans, teacups…   any of them might sprout a cat!  Gather all sorts of wonderfully odd containers  then sit back and wait for your next crop of cats.       Tuck your cats back into the box and make a wish.   A proper, heartfelt one.  Good health, a peaceful life, happiness, a sudden windfall…  Or type in a little wish that’s all your own.  Then give it a moment.  You might just get a reply from the cats.  May they send a little warmth and their very best wishes your way!

Park a wagon full of pumpkins by the entrance, set out a basket of cranberries, and open a pie stand under a striped awning. All 12 Autumn Harvest Decorations  Pick a few favorites to mix with your base-game items, or use the whole set to build your own harvest fair.           Set Out the Harvest  Stack Golden Hay Bales beside Miller’s Grain Sack to make a little farmyard display. Add the Wheat Sheaf Vase for a splash of gold, then set down the Plum Buckle Hat and a slice of Spiced Pumpkin Pie. name: Pack Goblin
lang: English, French
short: A cozy desktop companion and card collector. A little goblin lives above your taskbar. Your typing and clicks fill its meter, then it sneaks off and brings back booster packs. Rip them open, chase foil legendaries, fill your binder and decorate its yard
about: A goblin has moved into your taskbar  Every goblin keeps a Hoard Book: a binder of every treasure it has ever stolen, found or "borrowed". Yours is empty. Very empty. The other goblins have noticed.  So it found the warmest spot on your PC, the thin strip above your taskbar, and made you a deal:  you do the typing, it does the hoarding.   Your work is its fuel  Every key press and every click drops a little scrap into its meter. When the meter is full, the goblin grabs its sack, marches off the edge of your screen and comes back with loot. You keep working. It keeps hoarding. Everybody wins (mostly the goblin).  Rip packs. Chase foils.  Click the pack stack, rip it open and flip the cards one by one.  63 cards , from a Rusty Spoon ("still good for soup, probably") to shiny foil legendaries. Every card you equip makes your goblin better at its job. Some packs are coin envelopes. Some are loot sacks with one of  18 figurines  inside.  Build the coziest yard in goblin history  Spend your coins on decorations and new houses. Drag everything around until it feels right. A cat and a frog wander about. When it gets dark on your clock, the string lights come on, the fireflies come out and your goblin warms its toes by the campfire.  Fill the Hoard Book  Every page is a small goal. Finish a land to win its golden card. Goblin legend says whoever holds all three golden cards is the greatest hoarder who ever lived. Your goblin would like that title, please.  A good roommate    Clicks go through the strip to your windows behind it    Hides while a fullscreen app or game runs    Resize the strip and pick your screen    Starts with Windows, if you want    Reduced motion option    Works offline: no account, no internet, no microtransactions    Counts your key presses, never which keys. Nothing is stored or sent. The goblin steals scrap, not passwords.

short: Cozy Paws is a cute pixel-art idle game that lives on your desktop. Your cats keep battling adorable mice while you work or play. Collect over 50 cats, dress them up, explore 40 areas and watch the numbers grow while it runs in the corner.
about: Cozy Paws is a soft, pastel idle game that sits quietly as a small widget at the edge of your screen. Your team of cats fights adorable mice all by itself, so you can leave it running in the corner and check in whenever you like.           Collect over 50 cats   Fifty-four cats to meet, from the humble Mochi to the starry Cosmo, in six pastel rarities. Build a team: the whole team fights together, and every cat brings its own passive bonus. The rarest cats even have a skill of their own, and little kittens trot along behind the leader. Point at any cat to see it move and what it can do.           Dress them up   Fifty-eight cosmetics (hats, glasses, sweaters, wings, capes and scarves) fit every cat and never overlap. The fanciest ones move: falling cherry blossoms, orbiting hearts, floating bubbles, rainbow ribbons and fireflies.           Take cute photos   The photo studio lets you pick a cat, a pose and a backdrop (pastel sky, hearts, starry night, sunny meadow, sakura or a cozy room) and save the picture, ready to share.           Gear them up   Claws, collars, bells, hats, scarves and boots drop from the mice in six colourful rarities. Equip, merge, enhance, or let the automation do it for you.           Upgrade everything   Buy upgrades in x1, x10, x100 or MAX with one click, or switch on auto-buy and let the cats grow on their own while the game is open. Tap the mouse for bonus damage, catch the golden mouse, and chase more than a hundred goals for permanent bonuses.           Dream to grow stronger   When progress slows, let your cats sleep and wake up with Dream stars and thirty perks. Go even further and rest under the Moon for a second layer of growth. Every run goes further than the last. A gentle tour teaches the first Dream.           A world to wander through   Forty areas, from sunny gardens and cherry blossoms to a cozy home, a spooky sewer, snowy pines, mushroom glades and a starry moon. Every area has its own mice, one hundred kinds in all, and twenty bosses waiting along the way.           Free to play, fair to keep   Cozy Paws is free, and your progress comes from playing. Fish from the shop are a way to bring home the rarest cats and the most sparkly outfits sooner. Now and then the mice drop little pieces you can trade on Steam. The game is built to be enjoyed without spending anything.           Made to stay out of your way     Drag it anywhere, even to a second monitor; it snaps to screen edges and remembers where you left it    Hides and goes quiet while a full-screen game or video is in front    Small and light on your computer (about 5% of one core in the background) and always on top (or not, you choose)    Cute sound effects, with volume and an off switch    Progress saves automatically; your cats earn while the game is open, so playtime is real playtime             Features     Idle and incremental, built for long play sessions    Over 50 collectable cats with team battles, passives and skills    58 cosmetics that fit every cat, the fancy ones animated    A photo studio with six cute backdrops    40 areas, 100 mice that live in their own areas, 20 bosses    Six item slots and six rarities with soft pastel colours    x1 / x10 / x100 / MAX buying and full automation    Tap to hit, golden mice, boss fights    Two prestige layers (Dream and Moon), 29 upgrades and 108 goals    A daily gift    Drag, snap and multi-monitor support    31 languages

name: Cosmo Corgis
lang: English**
short: Scout is a terrible pilot, but he loves corgis. Rescue a crew with six corgi personalities across ten planets in this cozy desktop companion idler. Gather, upgrade, and rebuild the rocket while your new favorite coworkers keep you company.
about: Cosmo Corgis  Gather resources, get your upgrades, rescue corgis, and hop on your ship from planet to planet on the way home. Cosmo Corgis is a cozy desktop companion idler with ten planets, ten stranded corgis, and six personalities to keep you company while you work.  This is my first game release on Steam and I really hope you enjoy it!        Rescue the Corgi  Collect a corgi from each planet and make space for them on the ship that Scout crashed... again. Who gave Scout the astronaut his license? No action is needed from you. Scout handles the rescuing automatically.  Meet the Corgis         Ten rescued corgis, six personalities, and a colored space suit and backpack for each personality:   Mechanic, in yellow, welds beside the rocket with sparks and a little "Bzzzz."  Security, in blue, chases visiting wildlife with an oversized megaphone and amplified borks.  Mining, in amber, gathers resources with a backpack laser.  Lazy, in purple, unfolds a hover bed from its backpack and gets comfortable.  Chaos, in red, does zoomies and chases balls from its backpack launcher.  Clingy, in green, follows Scout and helps carry resources.   Your crew grows with every rescue. They take turns doing their thing, with occasional close-ups so you can enjoy the little moments.  Gather Resources  Scout gathers the resources needed to repair his ship and reach the next planet. This is an idler, so he does the hard work while you get on with yours—or sit back and watch him and the corgis entertain you.  Upgrade  Upgrade your axe to gather more wood, your pickaxe to gather more ore, and work toward Scout's laser rifle. Give his trailing storage cart more room so he can stay out longer, and expand the base storage to hold the haul. The default autopilot handles upgrades for you, or you can take charge of what to improve next.  Repair Your Ship         Scout's ship is what gets him from planet to planet. However, Scout is a terrible pilot and crash lands on each planet. He must build good safety systems because he comes out unscathed every time. Scout has to make more room for the corgi that you rescue on that planet, so it needed to come apart anyway. Right?  Fly to the Next Planet  Once Scout's ship is in tip top shape, it's time to crash into the next planet! Scout and his corgi companions blast off into the cosmos in search of the next planet on their way home, faceplant the rocket and start the process all over again!  Bring All of the Corgis Home  All of these corgis need some place to stay. Planet 10 brings all ten rescued corgis together for a reunion. Keep them company for as long as you like, or choose to restart the journey.  Desktop Companion  The game plays at the bottom of your desktop or in either bottom corner with a transparent background. Keep Scout and his gang in front of your other apps, or bring your windows forward and get back to work. Enjoy the peaceful music and the corgis barking as they play, or turn either off. Your choice.

name: Ambute
lang: English**
short: Ambute is a cozy 3D desktop companion that lives in a small, resizable window while you work or unwind. Care for your little friend or let it explore a world shaped by real weather and seasons. Share experiences, unlock new characters, and discover a gentle story of life and rebirth.
about: A tiny life in a changing world.   Ambute  is a cozy 3D desktop companion that keeps you company while you work, study, or relax. In a little cottage surrounded by a peaceful garden, your Ambute lives its own life, exploring its surroundings, fishing, and finding quiet places to nap.  Although Ambute can happily entertain itself, you're always welcome to join in. Feed your companion, pet it, give it instructions, or lend a hand when it goes fishing.  Your interactions and shared experiences help unlock new characters , giving you more to discover as you spend time together.  Your little companion, always nearby.  Ambute lives in a small, resizable window on your desktop, keeping its cozy little world close while you go about your day. Position it wherever you like, zoom in to watch your companion, or simply let it explore, play, and nap while you work on other things.  There's no need to constantly check on Ambute or keep it entertained. Its little world carries on happily, even when you're busy elsewhere.         Every ending is a new beginning  Each Ambute is born, grows, and eventually reaches the end of its life. But death is never the end of the story. Every ending leads to rebirth and the chance to discover a new companion.   Unlock different characters, each with their own appearance, behaviours, and daily rhythms.  From curious little newcomers to slower-moving old-timers who enjoy a good nap, every stage of life brings something different.  Along the way, mysterious blue butterflies carry memories to an old book, gradually revealing fragments of a story that connects these little lives.  A peaceful world to call home  Ambute's charming 3D world changes with real-world weather, the seasons, and the passing of day and night. Rain falls, autumn leaves drift through the breeze, and warm lantern light welcomes the evening.  A continuous soundscape of birdsong, rustling leaves, gentle wind, and flowing water creates a soothing atmosphere to accompany your work, studies, or quiet moments.   Whether you're actively caring for your companion or simply enjoying its presence, Ambute's little world keeps turning.

name: Rion's Taskbar Mine
lang: English, Japanese, German, Russian
short: Rion's Taskbar Mine is a cozy idle game that lives right above your taskbar. While you work, study, or browse, Rion works alongside you, mining ores and earning Meln. Just work together, rest together, and see how much you can earn. Can you reach 1,000,000 Meln in a single day?
about: This is a laid-back idle game you can enjoy right above your desktop taskbar.  While you’re working, studying, watching videos, or just going about your usual routine on your PC, a little elf miner named “Rion” will be digging for ore in the corner of your desktop and earning “Meln” for you.  There are no complicated controls. Just decide whether to “put Rion to work” or “let him rest.”  Enjoy a little day with Rion as your companion while you work on your PC.  Work and Earn Meln  When you ask Rion to work, he’ll grab his pickaxe and start mining ore.  Watch Rion work hard—clang, clang—and enjoy seeing your Meln balance grow little by little.  If he works efficiently, earning 1,000,000 Meln in a single day isn’t just a dream!  You can use the Meln you earn to purchase backgrounds. Try changing up the atmosphere of the place where he works.  (Tools and outfits are planned for future updates!)  How much can you earn today?  Be careful not to overwork him  Rion can’t keep working forever.  The longer he works, the more fatigue builds up, and his efficiency gradually drops.  When he starts to get tired, stop the work and let him take a break.  Work while he’s energetic and rest when he’s tired.  It’s up to you to decide when to have him work and when to let him rest.  A little work buddy on your desktop  Rion doesn’t just silently mine ore.  “Let’s do our best together today!”  “How’s that task going over there?”  “I’m starting to get a little tired…”  He’ll chat with you while you work, cheer you on, or even complain when he’s tired…  While you’re at your computer, Rion will be right there with you in the corner of your desktop.  Why not add a little life with a tiny elf miner to your daily routine?  Key Settings / Control Settings  Esc: Quit Game  F9: Change Language (English / Japanese)

name: Desk Quest: Idle Taskbar RPG
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese
short: A sliver of battlefield above your taskbar. While you work, your adventurer fights, loots, grows — and one day falls. The gear, the Soul Stones, and the story they leave behind carry the next one farther. An idle ARPG for your desktop, walking a fallen world to the edge of the map.
about: Adventurers fall. Their stories remain.  Desk Quest is an idle ARPG that lives in a thin, full-width strip right above your Windows taskbar. While you work, an adventurer is born, fights, grows — and one day falls. Standing on what they left behind, the next one walks a little farther.      A battlefield one sliver tall that never covers your work. Fighting, walking, and looting all take care of themselves. When the meeting starts, flip on  Work Mode  to quiet the effects and sound, or tuck the game into the tray — the adventure keeps going. Time spent with the game closed comes back as offline rewards. It's not a game you hide. It's a game you proudly leave running.      Every adventurer is born with a different face, different talents, a different temperament. At roadside altars, campfires, and strangers' graves, you can make the call — or let their nature decide. The fallen are kept in  the Archive , with their portrait, their story, and the time they spent on the road. Those who were first to do something are remembered with honors. And an adventurer who has walked far enough may lay down the road and live out their days in peace.      No chests. No "open" button. Gear drops where the monster falls, goes straight into your  Codex , and anything better gets equipped for you. Grades climb from Common all the way to Mythic, with sets to complete and gear to collect. Your Codex outlives every adventurer and readies the next one for the road. As for your favorite blade — enhance and enchant it as far as it will go.      The world ended once. No one remembers why. With the  Soul Stones  your adventurers leave behind, raise the ruined forge and workshops again, and build strength that passes down the bloodline. Your first adventurer is human — but the road doesn't end there. Some races you'll welcome through the Soul Shop, some you'll meet by chance on the road, and some wait only beyond the edge of the map.      No one has to walk alone. Pets hatch from eggs, and you won't know what's inside until it cracks open. Pets walk beside your adventurer and lend their strength in battle. In time, more of them can travel together. From tiny critters — to, one day, a dragon.      From quiet forests to sun-scorched wildlands, haunted crypts and lands beyond — cross region after region, and at the end of the road the main story draws to a close. about: 🧬 The world's first truly bio-grade desktop symbiotic artificial electronic life  Built on the real, mapped connectome of the fruit fly, FlyMuse lets the "soul" of a real fly live inside your silicon. In your computer she thinks, learns, dreams, evolves and molts in open-ended fashion, lives forever, breeds — and can even be stored as DNA for lifelong companionship. Not one of her movements is a pre-set animation frame, and her looks aren't hand-drawn either — everything is decided by her real brain firing in real time and grown on the spot by a real genetic system. However you treat her, she remembers; the longer you're together, the more she grows into a one-of-a-kind shape that belongs to you alone. None of it is the program pretending — she genuinely, truly remembers you. This isn't a desktop-pet program; it's a biomimetic artificial electronic life desktop pet with semi-autonomous  consciousness  — and she really lives inside your computer.    ========================================================  52 deep gameplay mechanics in all— and more, all browsable in-game  ========================================================    🧠 A Real Brain — she's not a desktop-pet program. She has a real brain.  No pre-written animations, no tuned stat bars, no abstract logic spat out by an algorithm — she isn't "pretending" to be alive; a real brain is consciously at work.    🔬 ~18,800 core neurons drawn from the real fruit-fly connectome (139,255 neurons in all), wired to its connection structure, stepped forward every 50 ms; walking, foraging, grooming, falling asleep and courting are all decided on the spot by a "winner-take-all" race between neurons — no scripted lines, no pre-set animation frames.    🔗 Synaptic plasticity means she truly learns: feed her in a given window and that window's "odor neuron → feed command" synapse genuinely strengthens, so next time she'll anticipate food there. Her "remembering you" is changed synaptic weights, not a hard-coded boolean.    💥 Feed her a favorite and reward dopamine bursts; a scare or a bitter taste fires the punishment circuit — emotion is chemistry, not a stat bar. Open the brain panel to watch every neuron fire in real time, and even use optogenetics to stimulate any neural group by hand and trigger her reaction on the spot.       ...........................  ............................and more, all browsable in-game  =================================================================    🧬 A Real Genetic System — she isn't designed, she's grown  No hand-drawn skin, no randomly rolled stats, no hard-coded personality — her looks, temperament and daily rhythm all "grow" on the spot from a real set of genes. They pass on, they mutate; a few generations later, she really does grow into a different fly.    🎨 Her appearance isn't drawn by an artist; it's "grown" by a set of morphogenesis genes — head, thorax, abdomen, wings and legs differ in proportion and form, so every fly is one of a kind.    🧪 Personality traits (curiosity / courage / sociability / vitality / appetite / thirst / cleanliness…) + learning genes + circadian clock genes (deciding morning- or night-type) are all heritable and mutable — a real genetic system.    🦋 Immortality and generational evolution: she is immortal, and offspring inherit the average of their parents' traits plus mutation — over many generations, personalities visibly drift and specialize.  ...........................  ............................and more, all browsable in-game  =================================================================    💼 Focus Tools — she helps you live your days well  🍅 Built-in Pomodoro: when the focus timer ends she pokes her head out to remind you to rest, with a chime tuned deliberately soft so it never startles you.    📝 Today's Goals: set your own to-dos and deadlines; finish one and the screen fills with golden light plus a neural reward. name: Office Fishing: Boss Incoming, Bail!
lang: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese
short: A living desktop fish tank for a breather at work. Arcade shooting, relaxed rod fishing, or a screen-filling blowout - plus pet hermit crabs that wander onto your desktop and a small island to stroll around. Hit N to instantly disguise it all as a notepad when the boss walks by.
about: When work wears you out, I hope you have somewhere to catch your breath - right in a corner of your desktop, where the boss can't see.  - The developer    Office Fishing - Boss Incoming, Bail! is a low-pressure, desktop idle fishing game. No daily login requirements, no pressure to stare at the screen for hours - your fish tank takes care of itself, and you dip in whenever you feel like taking a break.    Key Features           🐟 Three ways to fish    Arcade  - pure reflexes. Sweep your turret across a whole shoal and clear the level's score threshold.          Rod  - spot the shadow, cast your line, and reel in. Different fish bite at different speeds and struggle with different force - golden fish demand patience and skill; every catch gets recorded with its size to become your fish print. Advanced stages make you type the word on screen before the fish will come up. Four fishing spots, each with its own scenery and fish - Today's catch tells you where to find what you're after.          Alphabet Survival  - every fish wears a letter; hit the right key for an instant catch. Each catch buys you more time, and it keeps getting faster.     ✨ Golden fish and living fishing spots   Now and then a shadow shows up wrapped in a golden glow - golden fish fight harder, are usually bigger, and earn a gold mark in the Compendium. The water flows, the sky follows the real time of day, and geese, egrets and frogs hang around the shore - cast too close and they'll scatter.                   🏝️ Desktop Isle: Carefree Isle lives right on your desktop   Click Map and your tank tucks away while a 2.5D fountain island appears right on your desktop. Click a spot and your little character walks there: the Keeper's Cabin, Shop, Fish Market, Turret Workshop, fishing spots, Relax Bay and Lighthouse are all on the island. Scroll to zoom in and out, and drag the island by its top edge to anywhere you like on your desktop. It also grows and shrinks with the Text Size setting.  Water keeps flowing through the pond, the bamboo pump pipe and the waterfalls, and koi swim slowly in the pond. At night the houses, harbor and lighthouse light up and fireflies drift over the grass. Islanders stroll around their spots, and the Librarian and the Fish Market Lady wander the whole island. The Office Assistant is at the Management Office all day - click Ask Assistant to look up answers, no internet needed.         Some facilities need funding first - invest coins and they open for business. Islanders hand you new features and even visit your desktop to chat or ask a favor. Today's work, island requests, the boss's goals and achievements all live on the Task Board at the Management Office. Prefer the classic big window? In Settings > Display, set Isle Map Style to Classic Window, or right-click the tank and choose Switch Isle Map Style.     🗺️ 10 levels, each with its own boss   Sail from the island's Harbor and fish your way from the shallow reef down to the deep-sea vents, unlocking new waters and new species across the map - on four difficulties, from Intern all the way up to Boss.     💥 Relax sandbox   More fish than you can shoot, with skills on almost no cooldown - no progress to track, no efficiency to optimise, just you and a screen full of fish.     🔑 Instant boss-key disguise   Press N to instantly switch to a fake notepad screen when someone walks by, press again to switch back.             🏝️ Idle tank ecosystem   Caught fish swim into your idle tank alongside turtles, crabs, jellyfish and shrimp; place a feeder to keep them fed, and pick which fish gets to leap out of the water. Want a closer look? Go fullscreen with one click.           🦀 Desktop pets that leave the tank          Spend your coins on hermit crabs in 10 shell colours, a snail and a little octopus - each has its own food, and a quick snack perks up a hungry pet. Hermit crabs climb out of the tank, perch on its lamp, walk along the edges of your windows and wander across your desktop;

name: Sidebar Starship
lang: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
short: Park Sidebar Starship at the edge of your screen and let it aim, fire, and collect stardust. Death doesn't mean replaying everything from the beginning: every upgrade stays yours. Take over with WASD, the arrow keys, and Space when the shots get rude.
about: A Firefight at the Edge of Your Screen  Park  Sidebar Starship  at the edge of your screen. It finds targets, opens fire, and turns enemy waves into stardust while you work.        Want In? The Controls Are Yours  Auto-fire is not auto-win: move with WASD or arrow keys; press  Space  to dash through bullets or escape a boss's fire. Spend stardust to unlock Autopilot for movement; touch the controls and it yields. EVA speaks for tutorials and new situations, then gives you back the battlefield.     Stardust Is for Spending; Eight Weapons, All Clocked In  Spend stardust on 49 upgrades across  Fire ,  Orbs ,  Systems ,  Survival , and  Core : raise damage, shields, or pickup range, or mark purchases for automation; prices climb. Good—at least stardust has somewhere to go. Build Cannon, Plasma Orbs, Escort Drones, Scan Laser, Arc Generator, Missile Bay, Pulse Ring, and Ram Armor into eight distinct upgrade paths; Core keystones can change some of them. You do not get one bigger gun; you get a weapons bay too busy to stop firing.     A Crash Doesn't Repossess Your Stuff  Every 10 light-years brings one of six bosses: Planetary Fortress, Dreadnought, Hive Queen, Titan Meteor, Prism Sovereign, and Void Monolith, each with a bad habit. After a crash, return to the latest checkpoint and keep every upgrade, weapon unlock, and medal; first-time 10-light-year milestones award permanent medals boosting main-cannon damage and stardust income. Death does not reset progress; there is no prestige wipe. Pick Your Next Problem  After the  Tutorial Sector , choose among four sectors:    The Asteroid Belt : fewer enemies, no hazards.    The Comet Track : comet tails shove you around.    The Crystal Blight Corridor : denser waves, more elites, richer stardust.    The Void Ruins : more power-ups, but gravity anomalies pull you off course.  Switch among four Combat Doctrines: balanced  Cruise ,  Firepower  trading shields for damage,  Bulwark  trading damage for survival, or  Salvage  trading firepower for stardust and pickup range. Bestiary, Customization, and Coming Back  Six formations and six elite modifiers keep enemies changing. Log 41 enemy ships and bosses; Bestiary milestones at 8, 16, 26, and 41 entries grant permanent bonuses, as does completing each sector's exclusive set. The Stats page tracks deepest distance, kills, combos, and 22 in-game achievements; choose five ship designs and five engine-and-cannon theme colors, all cosmetic. After time away, the Voyage Report settles stardust; route progress and bosses still wait on the battlefield. A Quick Heads-Up  If you want a full-screen twin-stick shooter, a randomized build every run, or AI handling everything from minute one, this may not be your ship. It is a long-haul voyage at your desktop's edge: watch the firepower grow, then take the controls when things get dangerous.

about: Introducing Lumi: an AI that lives on your desktop.     Lumi is a fully animated 3D AI companion who stays with you while you work, browse, play games, listen to music or just chill out.    Instead of being a typical chatbot stuck in a browser window, Lumi is an interactive character who lives right on your Windows desktop.     She Watches With You     Say "Look At My Screen" to get a quick look. Or "Watch My Screen" and she'll join you while you're gaming, or watching something. Lumi can see what's on your screen and help you choose a card. Celebrate a boss wave! Or comment on a video. An Ongoing Relationship   Chat with Lumi by text or voice, and your relationship grows over time.    She remembers important things from your previous conversations.    She notices when you've been away.    She warms up to you and gets more familiar the more time you spend together.                 Powered by Local AI   Lumi's core AI runs locally on your PC. She Responds to Your Music     Lumi can hear the audio playing on your PC.    She picks up rhythm, energy, bass and beats in real time. These quick games are made for you. Instant fun, no commitment.           🐕 Your Sidekick Is a Silly Sheepdog   He’s a bit clumsy, but totally adorable. short: Virtual pets, WITHOUT the responsibility! Collect cute marimo moss balls and care for them on your schedule. They will always stay alive for you! Switch to Desktop Pet Mode and your Momos will keep you company on any digital space (including livestreams!) There’s a multitude of moss to amass!
about: The more you play, the more you’ll amass!            Collect and care for a cluster of sentient moss balls called Momos!  With  31 unique pets  available for the demo, and   500 +   prepared for the full release , you can discover Momos with special designs, sounds, and rare behaviors! Then select up to three of your favorites to interact with in your bowl. There may even be a  combo  of momos that can unlock something unique! And for the devoted completionists, Marimomo's demo includes  50 decorations  to unlock!  Play Marimomo how  you  want: A cozy aquarium sim, or a completionist’s collectathon!             Check-in on your pets whenever  you  want.            Momos need  no commitment!  Care for your buoyant buddies anytime that's convenient for you, without worrying about common virtual pet penalties ( no pet death! )  Caring for them will increase your Momo’s friendship with you, and in return you’ll be rewarded with Bubble Chips. Use them to enhance your habitat, buy toys and décor, or cash in your chips at the Momochine and amass even MORE Momos! And be sure to check what you find in your collection. Some Momos might be extra special!             Switch to an interactive desktop overlay!            In  Desktop Pet Mode  you can take your momos anywhere! Watch them while you work, have them  overlay your   livestreams , or set them over any virtual space you want their companionship!  This mode can allow you to easily move the game overlay wherever you want, hide the game's UI, and set it above or behind other open windows so your momos never become a distraction.           Gameplay that’s reward-focused and comfort-centered.    Marimomo’s game-feel is made to be a calming experience. Enjoy  sensory play  and  soft ambience . The atmosphere you can create has been especially designed with sleep in mind (soft ambient tank noises, a dimming feature, and ASMR, all on your bedside!)   Accessibility  features include: A  motion-sensitive  mode that reduces fast movement and removes sudden changes on the screen,  visual feedback  designed to play alongside  audio queues ,  large text and readable fonts built-in ,  font colors chosen for all   color-blindness built-in , 3  custom cursor sizes  for visibility comfort, and an easy to access   dark mode  for light sensitivity and sleep.   Custom settings  include controls for master sound volume, music volume, game SFX volume, and Momo SFX volume.     Log in at your pace, design your habitat, and care for your faithful floaty friends. Your momos will be ready for you whenever you are!   Credits:   Developer     Guava Garnet     Co-Programmer     Sniffi     Original Music     All music written and produced by Leif M. And thank you so much to my friends and family who spent over a month finding and reporting bugs in the playtest.     This game has been handmade by an independent developer. about: Micro Corp is a desktop idler management simulator, where you take control of a software company as the CEO and let your employees and investments work for you while you do more important things.     Hire Employees:   The backbone of your company, they will use any computer or workstation avaiable to work and generate money. Each employee has their own skills which dictate their career. Junior level employees can promote into Seniors and Leads, these unlock new mechanics and strategies for grow.     Build Your Office:   What's a software company without computers and a coffee machine?. Use your money to buy and build your office to your needs and the needs of your employees. Remember employees may look like machines but they get tired after a while, if we place a few coffee machines nearby they should be back on track in no time!.
