name: Cornerfall
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
short: A text-based idle RPG that lives in the corner of your desktop. Build your character, send them into cursed lands, and check back to find new loot, defeated bosses, and higher tiers unlocked. All without lifting a finger.
about: You start with disappointing gear and no idea what you're doing. That's fine. Your character doesn't need you for the fighting part.  Cornerfall is a text-based idle RPG. You pick a zone. You pick a tier. Your character walks in alone and the log starts scrolling. Combat, loot, death, all of it ticking by  while you do something else. When you check back, the inventory is full and something has changed.  A new sword. A better helmet. 12 Gold. A name in the log you haven't seen before.  No sprites. No maps. No fluff. Are you sold yet?  It plays itself.          Your job is the space between runs. Equip the sword or sell it. Allocate your stats. Unlock upgrades. Pick a zone or a boss and send your character back out. Alt-tab.          Make it yours.  Every zone, enemy, item, upgrade and line of flavor text is plain JSON. Drop a folder into the Mods folder and restart.

name: Tiny Ducks: Desktop Bath Demo
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Portuguese - Portugal, Polish, Korean
short: Tiny Ducks: Desktop Bath is a relaxing desktop idle game where you collect cute rubber ducks and let them float on your Windows taskbar. Unlock new ducks while you work or browse the web, and turn your ordinary desktop into your own personal tub.
about: Look down at your screen. Your plain taskbar turns into a playground for cute ducks!  'Tiny Ducks: Desktop Bath' is a desktop idle game where you collect and watch ducks floating in the corner of your screen. Enjoy a little splash of relaxation and calming music right under your monitor amidst your busy daily life.           Complete your collection of 40 unique ducks  The ordinary and familiar yellow rubber duck is just the beginning! Collect all 40 special ducks designed with warm pixel art. Just leave it on your screen while you go about your day, and new ducks will unlock one after another. Feel the satisfying sense of accomplishment as you fill up your neatly designed collection.     Little friends that won't interrupt your daily life  Just by leaving the game running, various rubber ducks will settle at the bottom of your screen. Featuring natural physics, you can observe their cute behavior as they bump into each other or bounce around. Whether you're coding, playing another game, or watching a video, the ducks will quietly and peacefully stay by your side.           Key Features      Seamless taskbar integration:  No need to open a large, separate game window. The ducks float naturally using your Windows taskbar as their tub.     Endless duck collecting:  From normal yellow rubber ducks to rare ones with unique personalities, fill your duck collection through idling and collecting.     Physics-based interactions and hidden fun:  Nudge the ducks with your mouse! Along with physical reactions like bouncing or being pushed around, some special ducks show cute, unique interactions every time you click them. Find out for yourself which ducks have hidden charms.     Soothing soundtrack to comfort your mind:  Peaceful background music perfectly matches the scenery of floating ducks, gently melting away the stress in front of your monitor.     Lightweight optimization:  Designed to be lightweight so you can comfortably leave it running in the background even during resource-heavy tasks.

name: Tiny Timber Demo

short: Tiny Timber is a 3D cozy idle game that lives on your desktop. Watch a tiny lumberjack chop trees, take breaks, and collect wood. Buy upgrades and grow your little forest while you work or relax.
about: A Tiny Forest, Right On Your Desktop!   Tiny Timber is a cozy 3D idle game that brings a little forest to your desktop. Watch your hardworking lumberjack chop trees, collect wood, and take well-deserved breaks while you work, browse, or relax.   Chop, Rest, Repeat!   Your little lumberjack has a job to do! He walks from tree to tree, chops them down, and collects wood all on his own. When he gets tired, he'll head back for some rest before getting right back to work. Meanwhile, new trees grow to keep the cycle going.           Upgrade Your Lumberjack   Put your hard-earned wood to good use! Sharpen your axe, swing faster, improve your stamina, and speed up tree growth. Balance your upgrades to make your little lumberjack more efficient with every tree he chops.   Your Own Little Desktop Companion   Tiny Timber lives in a transparent window, blending right into your desktop without getting in your way. Move it around, adjust its size, and place it wherever you like.  Whether you're working, watching videos, or simply taking a break, your little lumberjack will keep busy in the background. Check in whenever you want, buy a few upgrades, and let him handle the rest.

name: Buns and Poops
lang: English, Japanese
short: A poop-collecting sim that turns your entire desktop into a bunny playground. Over 80 pixel-art bunnies hop across your screen as you work, settle into loaves, flop over, and leave poops behind. Trade the poops you collect for furniture and treats to make life with the bunnies even cozier.
about: Buns and Poops is a poop-collecting sim that turns your entire desktop into a bunny playground. Bunnies hop across your screen, loaf up, flop over, and leave little poops behind, all while you work. Trade the poops you collect for furniture and treats to make life with the bunnies even cozier. Collect Poops, Go Shopping The bunnies roam your desktop, scattering poops everywhere. Collect them whenever you like, and spend them on furniture, treats, and more.                Right on Your Desktop A bunny naps beside your open document while little poops dot the space around your icons. The bunnies make themselves at home on your everyday desktop, not inside a game window. You can keep them in front and let them get in the way of your work, or tuck them behind your windows and collect poops in peace.         Lovingly Detailed Pixel Bunnies They stand tall to look around, yawn, and sploot out flat. Even in tiny pixels, every move is true to life.          Meet over 80 bunnies, each with a coat color and pattern faithfully recreated from official breed standards. Admire every detail in the Bundex, your in-game bunny encyclopedia, right down to the nape, the paws, and the underside of the tail.         Bonding with Bunnies Bunnies love a little attention. Pet them, offer a treat, or roll a ball their way.         Call Your Favorite Bunny Add your favorite bunnies to your in-game phone, give them a name, and call them over anytime. Set an anniversary, like a birthday or the day you first met, and something special might happen when that day comes...         What This Game Isn't    Not a game that demands your attention : It's made to run alongside your other apps, perfect for short breaks or simply unwinding at your PC.    Not a pet-raising sim : You can feed them hay and treats, but bunnies don't grow up, get sick, or die. Just relax and enjoy your time with the bunnies.    Not an incremental game : No exponential numbers here. Poops add up at a bunny's pace, for relaxed, realistic poop collecting.

name: Guildlands - Necromancer Class

short: A new class for Guildlands. The Necromancer raises skeletons from the bones of the fallen and makes them burst against the enemy. Their minion carries over from fight to fight and lasts the whole expedition, even while you're not watching.
about: The bones of the fallen fight for you The Necromancer raises skeletons from the bones of the fallen. The minion strikes at their side and steps in front of blows, and when the moment comes, it bursts against every enemy at once. Bone Pact The Necromancer's two own spells spend bones and ashes instead of runes. Bones come from fighting and from Prayer, and beast and dragon bones make the minion stronger. A minion still standing carries over to the next fight: it lasts the whole expedition while you get on with your day. Another way to play Guildlands' 15 classes stay free. The Necromancer is not stronger than them: it's another way to fight, with its own trait and its own spells.      What's included   The  Necromancer  class: create characters of this class.   Its trait,  Bone Pact .   Two class spells:  Raise Skeleton , dropped by a boss, and  Bone Burst , earned through a quest.    50 bones  to get started, once per account.

name: Pixel defender
lang: Japanese, English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Indonesian, Ukrainian, Dutch, Greek, Swedish, Spanish - Latin America, Thai, Czech, Danish, Turkish, Norwegian, Hungarian, Finnish, Bulgarian, Vietnamese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Polish, Malay, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
short: An idle tower defense game where a pixel-art army fights for you in the corner of your screen. Earn gold to train your troops and grow your castle town, and build the strongest army around! The battlefield feels like an old favorite.
about: A huge enemy army is marching on your castle! Don't panic, though. Fighting is your soldiers' job. Pick your formation, then sit back with a cup of tea and watch.        Battles run themselves  Swordfighters charge in while Archers and Mages cover them from behind. Your soldiers fight without orders and bring back gold and gems. When a gauge fills, they fire off their Ultimate skill on their own, or you can save it for the right moment and trigger it yourself.        Marching on in the corner of your screen  The game runs in a compact borderless window you can drag anywhere. Leave it in a corner while you work or watch videos, and the battle keeps going. Every time you glance over, your gold has quietly gone up.        Train your army  Spend gold and gems to level up your soldiers. Hand them the charms you pick up, and the same soldier can pull off a whole new role. A Tavern and a Gem Merchant set up shop in your castle town, and watching shabby stalls slowly turn into proper shops is half the fun.        A battlefield that feels familiar  Pixel-art soldiers and menus straight out of an old RPG. Mid-battle, your troops chatter away with lines like "One arrow, one kill!" and "I'll show you the fruits of my training!" Even their "Guh... Is that all?!" when things get rough is part of the charm.        Build the strongest army!  Replay cleared stages for loot, rework your formation and weapons, and take on the next tough enemy. Landing an Ultimate skill cut-in never really gets old. Your goal: an army no horde can break through!        Animations play nonstop, reacting to whatever's happening in the game!

name: Your Momo
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese
short: Shortstack, Interaction, Desktop Companion. Your Momo is a narrative, cozy desktop game. Talk with Momo through playful spanks on her butt and build a deeper bond. Unlock new items through conversation and watch her draw freely on your desktop as time passes.
about: Your Momo  is a narrative-driven desktop companion game.     One day, a tiny, charming creature named  Momo  makes an unexpected crash landing right onto your desktop screen. Stranded in an unfamiliar digital world, Momo encounters you—a human—and begins an awkward yet heartfelt journey of connection. Discover a one-of-a-kind story blooming in the quiet corner of your everyday workspace.                  Connecting with Momo starts with a light touch. Break the ice and communicate with Momo through playful spanks to bring you two closer.                               The more time you share your screen with Momo, the richer her reactions, behaviors, and dialogue become. As your conversations grow, new items unlock, gradually filling Momo's little world with color, comfort, and memories.                              Don't worry if you need to focus on your work. When idle, Momo makes herself right at home—using your desktop as her personal canvas to doodle, sketch, and entertain herself.                              Momo is much more than just a decorative virtual pet; she is an affectionate daily companion. She listens to music alongside you, sparks casual conversations, and brings warmth to routine tasks. With practical built-in productivity tools like To-Do lists, she helps brighten and organize your day.

name: SummitJourney
lang: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
short: A little cat keeps climbing while you get on with your day. Keep it in a transparent desktop corner, enable automatic hiking and Do Not Disturb, then return to trail stories and finds. Idle and offline progress, optional repeat climbs, and about 150 real-world peaks await.
about: You get on with your day. Your cat keeps climbing.  SummitJourney is a cozy idle climbing game with a cat companion. Choose a peak, route and supplies, then shrink the same journey into an always-on-top, transparent desktop-pet form. Your cat keeps you company in a corner while you do other things. Automatic hiking and offline progress continue the same journey.  Quiet company, with stories to return to  Choose Quiet company to enable auto-eating, camping, conservative event choices and Do Not Disturb. Your cat handles trail events while the mailbox and journey log keep the results for later. Repeat climbs remain your separate choice, and normal risks and failure outcomes still apply. Click the cat to open its panel, check finds or change settings.      A mountain in the corner of your desktop  Keep the hiking window beside whatever you are doing. Click to unfold the panel, check your hiker, and adjust automatic care. Close the panel when you are done, and let your cat carry on along the trail.             Take the scenic route  Hide the interface and settle into immersive mode. Follow your cat through forests and drifting clouds, up toward the snowline. The scenery changes with the mountain, altitude, and weather. Find a view you love, and take a photo to remember it.            Every climb starts with a packed bag  Check the altitude and estimated journey, then choose from six routes. How much food and water should you bring? What else will fit? Review your load, supplies, and risks before taking the first step.        A little rest goes a long way  Keep an eye on stamina, fullness, and mood. Eat along the way, make camp after dark, and recover before climbing on. Optional automatic feeding and night camping help you care for your hiker at your own pace.        Make the summit. Make it home.  Mark your arrival at the top, then follow the trail back down. Once safely at the foot of the mountain, look over your time, stars, and souvenirs. Another peak will be waiting when you are ready.             Someone left a little surprise  An item beside the trail. A few words for a stranger. Open a treasure left by another hiker, read their message, and perhaps find a small gift from their journey.        Leave something for the next hiker  Choose an item from your bag, write a short note, and leave it beside the path you have walked. Placing a treasure costs stamina. You can cancel before confirming, and choose exactly what you want to pass along.        Share a stretch of trail  A fellow hiker’s recorded climb may appear along your route. Walk beside their past footsteps for a while. These encounters are asynchronous, so a little company can find you even when you are not online together.             Remember who you meet  Record animal encounters in your field guide. Open an entry to see the illustration, affinity, and habitat, and get to know the creatures you might meet again on another climb.        Bring a little of the mountain home  Learn where herbs grow and what they do, then plan supplies for a future trip. Collect summit mementos with lasting bonuses, so the things you bring home can help you on the next trail.        Grow into the next climb  Spend earned funds on physical training and stars on permanent skills. Clear costs, levels, and progress help you build the abilities you need before setting out for a mountain you have been eyeing.        Dress for your next adventure  Browse the looks and outfits you have earned, and pick a favorite. Along with your growing collection and hard-earned skills, a new outfit makes this little hiker feel more like your own.              Ghost trails and treasures require an internet connection and contain asynchronous player content. Names and messages can be reported. Some GIFs use marked sample hikers and data; treasure discoveries do not always include a gift. Mountains, routes, and geography are stylized for the game.

short: Fidget Toy Engine is a desktop app that lets you enjoy a variety of interactive toys. Spin, click, squish, roll, launch, and customize them while you work, study, or relax. Keep your favorites close in a transparent window with satisfying sounds and colorful styles.
about: Fidget Toy Engine brings a collection of interactive toys directly to your desktop. Open a compact transparent window, choose a toy, and keep a satisfying little distraction within reach while you work, study, chat, or take a break.            DISCOVER A VARIETY OF TOYS  Spin a fidget spinner or shuriken, squish slime, tap the keys on a mini keyboard, roll dice, fire a slingshot, send a roulette ball around the wheel, watch a DVD logo bounce, and discover much more. Every toy has its own way to move, react, or play.  Fidget Toy Engine is designed to keep growing, with more toys planned for future updates.         MAKE IT YOURS  Save your favorites or let Random choose for you. Resize the app, adjust volume and brightness, and recolor selected toys with custom colors and metallic finishes.         BUILT FOR YOUR DESKTOP  Place the transparent window wherever it works best for you. Keep it above other apps, minimize it to the system tray, or have it launch automatically when your computer starts. Stereo sound subtly shifts with the window's position across your desktop,    COMFORTABLE TO USE  Choose a dark or light theme, enlarge interface text, and tune frame rate, anti-aliasing, and shadow quality for your setup. The interface supports ten languages.    PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE  Steam achievements mark playful milestones, while Steam Cloud keeps supported preferences in sync. A little company on your desktop  Take a break from work or study to watch your fish swim through plants and around rocks. name: Your Wife and Your Mother
lang: Simplified Chinese, English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Danish, Ukrainian, Russian, Bulgarian, Hungarian, Indonesian, Turkish, Greek, Norwegian, Czech, Japanese, Polish, Thai, Swedish, Traditional Chinese, Romanian, Finnish, Dutch, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Vietnamese, Korean, Malay
short: Your wife and your mom have moved onto your desktop. They get hungry, they get tired, they bicker and sulk, and they eat peppers on their own. Plant peppers, fend off worms, launch fireworks — and watch the two of them go about their little lives in the corner of your screen.
about: - Two lively desktop pets     Your wife and your mom each have their own temper. They get hungry, tired, and grumpy — and they'll smile back when you take good care of them.     - Daily care     Light fireworks, talk, play, let them rest. Don't let any of the four stats run out — and if someone starves and collapses, a pepper brings them back.     - Desktop garden     Plant pepper trees on the left side of the screen. They sow and harvest on their own — and you'd better watch out for worms sneaking in to steal a bite. Kick them away.     - Fireworks workshop     Peppers can be crafted into firework tubes, and tubes can spell out words for letter fireworks. Dozens of explosion styles unlock as you play, combining into 18,000 different effects.     - Two-player drama     Your wife and mom start fights, make up, and whisper to each other on their own. The worse their mood, the more likely they hit back — no one-sided beatdowns here.     - Desktop-friendly     Adjustable size, mouse passthrough. The transparent window never gets in your way, and it steps aside automatically during fullscreen games.     - Mod skins     Any character you like can be a desktop pet. Built-in skin swapping — change characters freely.     - 39 achievements     From "First Harvest" to "Fireworks Expert" — and every achievement is celebrated with fireworks.            A wife and a mom, have moved onto your desktop   They get hungry, tired, and moody, and they secretly cheer up because you care. While you get on with your own things, they live their own lives in the corner of the screen — bickering over nothing, huddling up to whisper, and when they're really bored, going at each other.  Caring for them — Your wife and mom each have four stats: fullness, stamina, mood, and affection. When hungry they need peppers, when tired they need sleep, and when unhappy they need you to sit down and talk with them. Go too long without peppers and they'll collapse from hunger — feed them one pepper and they're back on their feet.  Planting a pepper patch — The garden is on the left of the screen, and pepper trees bear fruit one by one. Pick them to feed the girls, or save them as firework material. When fruit appears, stay sharp: worms will crawl in from the edge of the screen to steal a bite, and you'll have to get them up to kick it away — kick it cleanly and there's an achievement in it.  Putting on a fireworks show — Peppers can be crafted into firework tubes, and tubes can spell out words to launch letter fireworks. There are dozens of explosion styles, unlocked level by level the longer they're online — from the humblest little bloom all the way to a full-screen spectacle.  Watching them together — In two-player mode, your wife and mom start their own interactions: fights, make-ups, play, and whispers. Who hits back depends on their mood, and the worse it is, the more they retaliate — you'll never see one side just taking a beating. And if you can't stand watching, one drag of the mouse pulls them apart.  Desktop manners — Transparent window, scalable characters, mouse passthrough, menu and tray, all included. They never steal your focus, and you can mute them or send them all off to rest with a single click.

name: Saikei: A Zen Water Garden Demo
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese
short: A tiny voxel world in a glass jar that lives on your desktop. Dig with a toy shovel, pour sand and water, plant trees and build little houses, then watch crabs, fish and birds go about their day in stop-motion clay. No goals, no failing. Just a small world to poke at.
about: A miniature world in a jar, right on your desktop  Saikei is the Japanese art of making miniature landscapes in a tray. This one comes in a glass jar that sits in the corner of your screen while you work, and it stays out of your way until you reach in.  Inside is a little world of grass, sand, stone and water. A river runs down from a spring, drops over waterfalls and empties into a turquoise lake. Through the glass you can see fish, seaweed and coral, and the layers of soil show along the side of the jar like an ant farm. Dig, pour, plant, build    Shovel:  dig bowls and plough trenches. The dirt piles up around the edges and settles into place.    Bucket:  pour streams of sand that pile into dunes.    Watering can:  fill hollows, flood channels and redirect the river. Running water carries sand downstream and carves its own paths.    Blocks:  lay grass and stone wherever you like.    Trees and buildings:  plant pines, round trees and red maples, or put down cottages, a pagoda, stone lanterns and torches.   Stop-motion clay Everything looks and moves like claymation, a little jerky and a little wobbly. Every block you place squashes and settles. The creatures move as if someone were nudging clay figures one frame at a time. A world that carries on without you    Crabs  scuttle sideways along the beach, snip their claws and run off with claws raised when you dig too close.    Fish  swim in loose schools, nibble seaweed and come straight over when you sprinkle food.    Octopuses  rest on the lake bed and jet away when startled.    Birds  perch on rooftops and treetops, loop around inside the jar and sometimes dive for a fish. They always miss.   The jar keeps your hours. The sun rises and sets when yours does, windows light up at dusk and fireflies come out at night. Every so often a rain shower rolls through, and the river and waterfalls run full. Made to sit there all day   Light on your computer, so you can leave it running.   Never interrupts what you're doing.   Pick a jar: rounded, round, oval or a tall bell jar, in large or small.   Every new jar holds a fresh world, and yours saves automatically.   No goals, no score, no way to lose.   Leave it in the corner and let it grow on you, or spend ten minutes digging a canal to see where the water goes.

name: Galaxization
lang: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
short: A galaxy and civilization simulator on your Windows wallpaper. While you work, civilizations sprout, rise, trade, fight and fall among 200,000 stars. Pick the view: the whole galaxy, the black hole, a star system, or the sky from a planet's surface. Built in Rust: light on CPU and battery.
about: Your wallpaper is a galaxy of 200,000 stars, and on one of its worlds, someone has just begun to think.   Galaxization is a galaxy and civilization simulator that runs as your Windows desktop wallpaper. Behind your icons a procedurally generated galaxy slowly turns, and every day your PC is on, about two million years of its history go by: a first species leaves its homeworld and splits into rival nations that trade, found religions, go to war, build wonders, collapse and climb back.  It is a game you watch. The galaxy runs itself; you observe, explore and read. There are no fleets to command and nothing to win. No two galaxies share a history. Each happens once, and you are its only witness. Choose what your wallpaper shows    The whole galaxy.  A steady view from above, with every civilization's territory spread across the spiral arms.    The black hole.  The view from just above the accretion disk at the galaxy's centre, starlight bending around the shadow.    A star system.  Set any system you have flown into as the wallpaper, or follow one planet around its star.    A planet's surface.  Stand on the ground and make that sky your desktop: the sun rises and sets about every twenty minutes.    A civilization's capital.  The wallpaper follows it, and moves with it when the capital moves.    Or let the observatory choose.  It flies to where history is being made, tours the star systems worth seeing, or follows an ark in flight. Every view you save is one click away in the tray menu.   What you do    Leave it running.  Glance up between tasks: the wallpaper shows the year, the name of the age and the newest line of the observatory's log. Something worth reading happens about every half hour; a great power takes days to rise and fall.    Fly in.  Ctrl+Alt+G turns the wallpaper into a place you can move through: from the whole galaxy into any of 5,000 star systems, down to a planet, and onto its surface to watch the sun cross the sky.    Read its history.  Every civilization has a file: its character, its neighbours, what it has learned, what it believes, and its own chronicle since its founding.    Set the pace.  Time flows at 10 to 50 years a second, as you choose, and slows by itself when history is being made. Everything else is up to the galaxy.   It stays out of your way   Stops drawing when a maximized window or a full-screen game covers it; the history carries on. Idle on the desktop it draws ten frames a second on under 1% of the CPU, on integrated graphics, in a few hundred MB of memory.   Silent on the desktop by default; the orchestral score plays when you step inside. No extra account and no launcher: the game itself never goes online, and Steam handles achievements and cloud saves.   Turn the PC off and the galaxy waits for you.   A second monitor becomes the observatory console: every civilization side by side.   A galaxy built on real astronomy   Seven kinds of galaxy, from grand-design spirals to irregulars, nearly all with a ray-traced black hole at the centre: starlight bends around its shadow, and the side of the disk turning toward you burns brighter.   Planetary systems worked out from their star: habitable zones, giants beyond the snow line, multiple suns, white dwarfs, and tidally locked worlds whose people live in the twilight belt.   Life follows its chemistry: carbon life in water, silicon life in sulfuric acid, slow life in methane lakes at 90 K. Most habitable worlds stay barren or never get past microbes; in a whole galaxy only a few worlds, sometimes one, ever come to think.   The sky has consequences. A nearby supernova strips a world of its life. A sea people cannot light a fire, so metal comes late. A chemical rocket can barely leave a heavy planet.   The in-game Encyclopedia explains the model behind the numbers.   Science fiction, happening on its own   A sky where being heard is dangerous. about: Your kana, always within reach   Starting hiragana and katakana from scratch? Still drilling them into place? Or watching the ones you used to know quietly fade? Mame meets you wherever you are, one card at a time, in the spare moments you'd otherwise spend doing nothing.             Mame  is a desktop companion, a small black bean-cat with glasses, who lives in a corner of your screen and helps your Japanese stick. Whenever you have a spare moment, Mame offers a single card: read this kana, recall this word. Answer with a click, or wave it away for free. That's it.             Spaced repetition, working in the background   Mame runs an honest spaced-repetition engine. It shows you what you're about to forget, right when you're about to forget it, and keeps bringing new characters back around until they finally stick. Kana first, then N5 vocabulary. No cramming, no full-screen sessions. Just tiny, well-timed reviews scattered through your day.   All progress, no pressure   Every card you clear is a step forward, and it shows. Master a run of kana and Mame responds: new accessories to wear, new colors to try them in, a daily tally that keeps climbing. The loop only ever rewards.  Busy week? Nothing you've earned slips away. There's no streak to lose, no timer winding down, no backlog to grind through. Skip a card and it simply waits; dismissing costs nothing. Step away for a day or a month, and Mame welcomes you back exactly where you left off.             It fits into your day, not the other way around   Mame lives in a corner of your screen while you work, browse, or play, and steps in for a few seconds only when you actually have them. Never at a bad moment. No sitting down, no session to start, no schedule to keep. Practice happens in the gaps you already have.  Its focus is the foundation that pays off every day: both kana syllabaries, learned and kept sharp from your very first character, plus the everyday vocabulary you'll actually reach for. A little at a time, until it's second nature.   Meet Mame   Mame ("little bean") is a study buddy with a soft squish to every move and a whole vocabulary of expressions. The more you master, the more Mame's wardrobe grows: new accessories to wear, and new colors to try them in. Everything you unlock is a badge of what you've genuinely learned: your progress, made adorable.             Features     A charming desktop companion that lives quietly in the corner of your screen    Honest spaced-repetition drilling of kana and everyday N5 vocabulary    Bite-sized reviews that fit your spare moments: answer in seconds or skip for free    Unlock accessories for Mame, and colors for them, as you master more    A daily tally that celebrates every card you clear    Nothing you earn ever slips away: step away anytime and pick up right where you left off    Lightweight and relaxed: it sips resources and stays out of your way        Every card counts. Nothing is lost. Everything sticks.

name: Suzhou love words

short: 《Suzhou Love words》is a distinctive visual novel that skillfully blends romance and comedy. Set in Suzhou, the game offers players a uniquely local love story inspired by the city’s culture, scenery, and atmosphere.
about: You are an art student studying in Suzhou, pushed forward by the mounting pressure of graduation and the search for a job.  Between quiet canals, classical gardens, and misty rain, you step into Sushu’s studio. In this gentle old city, you begin to uncover the feelings she hides behind her smile—and find the courage to keep moving forward.  Later, you return to your hometown to serve as a groomsman at a classmate’s wedding. There, you reunite with Lin Feier, an old classmate from your school days. Long-buried feelings and missed opportunities begin to resurface.  Faced with two very different girls, what kind of romance and choices await you?  This is a romance visual novel featuring two heroines, both available to pursue. Your story is waiting to begin.             Susu             The owner of a studio in Suzhou, Susu is gentle and mature, carrying the calm elegance and quiet charm of a Jiangnan water town in everything she does.    She is always smiling as she takes care of the people around her, while quietly hiding her own disappointments and worries among rainy nights and glowing streetlights.    As you gradually grow closer to her, you may discover that beneath her seemingly effortless warmth lies a fragile heart longing to be understood.       Lin Feier             Your former classmate, whom you meet again after many years, has blossomed from the shy girl in your memories into a dazzling and captivating woman.    Intelligent and confident, with a hint of playful mischief and emotional distance, she always seems to know exactly how to make your heart skip a beat.    Yet beneath her brightness and teasing humor lie regrets from the past and feelings left unspoken, waiting to be brought into the light once more.     Ajuan           Susu’s assistant at the studio may look like a child, but she is, without a doubt, a true senpai. Despite her appearance, she is surprisingly capable and professional whenever she is working.    Sharp-tongued and fond of teasing, she is dramatic, mischievous, and always ready to turn a tense atmosphere into a burst of laughter.    Behind all her jokes lies a sincere dedication to the studio and the people she cares about, as well as a strong desire to protect them.           - 《Suzhou Love words》is a romance visual novel featuring two heroines and two romance routes, set against the distinctive atmosphere of Suzhou.          The full release is expected to contain approximately  200,000 Chinese characters , with:    Full voice acting    Live2D animated character portraits    More than 100 CG illustrations    Cinematic direction and immersive visual presentation            Amid the misty beauty of Jiangnan and the realities of young adulthood, the game tells a story about love, companionship, and growing up.  Unlike traditional visual novels, which build emotional connections primarily through the story itself,  Whispers of Gusu  also includes a  desktop companion mode , available as a free DLC. Even after completing the game, you can continue spending time with your favorite characters as they accompany you while you work, study, or relax—bringing the romance beyond the story and into everyday life.         Visually, 《Suzhou Love words》 strives to deliver a high-quality presentation worthy of the best Chinese indie visual novels.  From the atmosphere of its environments and the performances of its characters to the unified style of its CG illustrations and animated portraits, every encounter, every flutter of the heart, and every emotional moment is supported by carefully crafted visuals.  The game’s art direction is based on the real streets and scenery of Suzhou. To accurately capture the city’s unique canals, gardens, neighborhoods, and everyday atmosphere, we conducted extensive field research, location visits, and reference gathering. name: Virtumon
lang: English
short: Adopt a mysterious virtual pet known as a Virtumon. Care for it, keep it alive, and guide it's evolution through countless possible forms. Train it for battle, send it on adventures, and uncover the secrets of the strange virtual world it calls home.
about: Raise and care for a virtual pet known as a Virtumon. A previously unknown lifeform made entirely of data. Virtumon inhabit file systems and moves freely across networks and devices. This software was created to contain them in a safe environment while we attempt to understand their true nature.                      Feed your Virtumon, pet it, and care for it when it's sick. Keep its needs fulfilled to help it live a long and healthy life. As you interact with your Virtumon, the bond between you will grow and you will shape its personality, behaviour, and future evolution.                        A Virtumon evolves through 6 distinct stages of life, with countless forms waiting to be discovered. Every evolution path has hidden requirements waiting to be uncovered. Can you complete the family tree to learn the truth behind each egg?                           Battle instincts are embedded deep within every Virtumon's digital DNA. While they can live a happy lives without fighting, only those pushed to their limits can unlock their full potential. Train your Virtumon, challenge powerful opponents, and help it reach its final form.                Eventually, every Virtumon must return to the great data stream beyond. But this is not the end.  Their data lives on, recycled and carried on into future generations.   If your Virtumon lived well and achieved its final form, it may even leave behind something for the next generations to use.

short: A cozy crypto-mining idle game: build your farm, ride the market, end each cycle with a halving, and chill to rain and lo-fi.
about: Late evening. Rain on the window, a moon and a little plant on the sill, a cat sprawled across the desk, and under it your mining rig purring away. Pour a coffee, put on some lo-fi, and mine made-up coins in the coziest crypto room there is.  ☕ Mine, sell, chill  A cozy idle clicker with no rush and no grinding for grinding's sake. Tap the screen to mine by hand, or build a farm that works for you. Watch the charts, wait for the right moment, and sell: the market breathes, and sometimes it breathes right into your pocket.  🖥️ Build your dream farm  From an old laptop to a hyperscale data center. The catch: power costs watts and heat, so keep the balance between compute, power, and cooling. Look away too long and the rig overheats while the room glows an anxious red. Out of space? Buy slots, sell old hardware, optimize.  📈 Ride the market  Three coins, three personalities: the boring but dependable $STBL, the lively $HASH, and the utterly unhinged meme coin $DOGE. And when @MuskRat tweets something again, the price shoots up ×3, and you get a couple of seconds to sell at the very peak.  🌙 Close the cycle, grow stronger  Squeezed everything out of a run? Do a halving: reset your progress and bank Warmth for permanent upgrades. Level up the Cozy and Scale branches, unlock the second tier with rare Quanta, and build a setup that turns a cozy hobby into a money printer.  🐦 Contracts and crypto Twitter  The feed is full of familiar faces: whales, pump prophets, people who lost their seed phrase, and just plain tired holders. Take contracts, mine the right coin, sell to a target, or hold out without overheating, and collect your rewards.  💤 Your rig works while you rest  Closed the game? The farm keeps mining. Come back for what's piled up and pick up right where you left off.  ✨ What's inside  ☕ A cozy idle with active clicking  🌧️ A lo-fi mood: night, rain, string lights, a sleeping cat  📊 A living market: volatility, pumps, and three coins with character  🔥 Farm management: power, cooling, and the fight against overheating  🌱 Deep prestige: Warmth, Quanta, and two upgrade branches  📝 Contracts and dozens of atmospheric tweets  🌙 Offline income and autosave  😼 Light crypto satire, no lecturing  No gas fees. No rug pulls. Just you, a warm room, and the soft sound of rain.

The game sits in the corner of your screen, making Lofelia a relaxing desktop companion for your everyday tasks.       A cozy incremental clicker game   Every time you press a mouse button or key on your keyboard, Lofelia will write a few words for her next book. Once finished you can publish books and place them on your bookshelf. Based on her books, Lofelia gets increasingly more productive, allowing her to write longer stories.               Decorate your bookshelf   Customize your growing bookshelf with differently colored books, plants and decorations. about: A little lake. A moment for yourself.  Seeds drift in across the water. Click one, and it takes root and grows into something beautiful.   My Secret Lake  is a cozy idle gardening game that brings a living lake to your desktop. Spend a few quiet minutes tending your plants, then let them grow while you get on with your day.            Catch  drifting seeds and watch them grow into flowering plants.   Collect  new species and the Spirit they produce.   Arrange  your lake and unlock new scenery.   Share  letters in bottles with players around the world.   Unwind  through rain, thunder, daylight and starry nights.   Let your desktop bloom  Keep your lake beside your work, reading, or downtime. Move and resize the window, pin it on top, collapse the menus, and enjoy floating plants against your own wallpaper. Turn the in-game background on whenever you want to step into the scenery.          Grow something worth coming back to  Raise plants, discover new species, and collect the Spirit they produce. Research upgrades to make more room, improve growth, and make everyday care easier.          Make the lake your own  Arrange your plants and unlock new scenery as your collection grows. name: MEMORY DEALER
lang: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal
short: You are a memory trafficker. Harvest stolen memories from captive minds and sell them to BRN CORP. Buy neural implants with your credits, but don't get addicted to your own supply, or you'll lose those memories forever. A shady cyberpunk idle game on your desktop.
about: **MEMORY DEALER**   You are a memory trafficker, street-level muscle in a cyberpunk economy that runs on other people's pasts. A captive brain glows in the corner of your desktop, and you sell what's inside it to BRN CORP, one memory at a time. The money is easy. Staying clean is not.          The Loop   Pulses drift across the brain. Tap one and a memory surfaces, paying you on the spot. Drop it into a slot and it sells itself to BRN CORP while you do something else. Commons pay slow and forever; Legendaries pay big and die fast. The skill is choosing what to run, and when to walk away.          Progression   Nothing here is infinite. Sell a memory dry and it refines, returning richer each time, and that gain never resets. Spend your credits on neural implants and upgrades, then wipe a spent brain to unlock the next: a new mind, a new past, a payout of Neurons for permanent upgrades that outlast every reset.         ### The Dealer's Brain   You can't stop using your own supply. The memories you've consumed start calling you back. RESIST costs cash, more every time. INDULGE costs nothing now and everything later: that memory is yours forever, jacked into your own skull, gone from the market, and its pulse rots into a phantom that drains your cash on sight. Your own brain fills in the same way, core by core, one glow for everyone you couldn't say no to.           ### Features     Always-on-top desktop widget that runs quietly while you work or browse    A procedural holographic brain rendered in real time: pure glowing neon visuals, zero art assets    5 unique brains, each a different person with a distinct look and a skewed spread of memories    119 memories sold to BRN CORP, from Commons worth pennies to Legendaries worth a fortune    Four upgrade paths competing for the same cash: HUSTLE (sale speed), HARVEST (pulse spawn rate), PIPELINE (queue depth and on-brain pulse cap), SCAN PROTOCOL (force-spawn a chosen rarity)    Permanent memory refinement: every memory grows more valuable with each extraction cycle, and the gains survive every wipe    Rapport streaks: sell the same memory on repeat and stack a growing bonus    The Dealer's Brain: resist your cravings at an escalating cash cost, or indulge and wire the memory into your own head forever as a cash-draining phantom    Neural implants and Neurons: permanent upgrades bought with your earnings that outlast every Memory Wipe    Fully localized in English, French, German, Spanish (LatAm), Brazilian Portuguese, and Simplified Chinese

name: Desktop Truck Simulator
lang: English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Finnish, Norwegian, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish*
short: Desktop Truck Simulator is a cozy, semi-idle trucking companion that runs quietly in the corner of your screen. Deliver charming cargo, collect lo-fi cassette tapes, take polaroid photos, collect trinkets, rest and socialize at roadside stops in a slow-burn world that respects your time.
about: Turn your screen’s idle time into a highway journey.    Desktop Truck Simulator  is an ambient, cozy trucking and logistics game designed to live alongside your daily computer workflow. Whether you’re writing code, studying, or browsing, a tiny lo-fi truck travels across your desktop, delivering retro game consoles, potted succulents, and warm coffee beans through scenic, low-poly landscapes.             It’s not about high-octane racing; it's about the peaceful hum of the engine, the glow of the dashboard at 2:00 AM, and the gentle progression of a long-haul trip.  Key Features:     Designed for your Desktop (Multiple Window Modes):      Small Corner Mode:  A compact window that sits neatly in your screen's corner.     Medium / Full-Screen Mode:  Pull over, open the cab, and take active control to customize your rig, browse the job board, socialize at stops, resolve roadside events, and plan your next route.     Taskbar Strip Mode:  A minimalist, zero-intrusion visual journey running right above your Windows taskbar.               Dashboard Terminal:  A compact terminal sits at the heart of your dashboard, putting everything you need for the journey within reach. Manage your drive, check your route and fuel level, and keep an eye on the road from the comfort of your cab.            The Cassette Deck:  Collect  cassette tapes and choose the music for your journey. Pop a tape into your dashboard deck and settle into warm lo-fi beats, the soft hiss of analog audio, and rain against the windshield.          A Personal, Lived-In Cab:  Personalize your truck’s dashboard with unique trinkets bought from roadside vendors or found along the road. Pin polaroids of your scenic photo-stops to your sun visor, and watch your passport accumulate beautiful stamps from every city you visit.           Warm Drinks and Lonely Roads:  Pull over at uniquely stylized low-poly truck stops, from neon-lit cyberpunk harbors to snowy mountain lodges. Rest, refuel, take photos, and share quiet, heartfelt conversations with late-night characters like ex-hauler baristas, retired radio hosts, antique vendors, or a slightly glitchy retro vending machine AI.          Atmospheric Road Events:  While you work, the highway tells its own stories. Encounter light, text-based narrative moments, from mysterious radio transmissions meant for someone else, to a stranded mechanic in the rain, to cozy late-night thoughts.       Late-Night Conversations:  Pull into a truck stop, grab a warm drink, and settle in for a conversation. Get to know the colorful people who live and work along the highway, with stories that unfold across multiple visits.    Progression That Respects Your Time:     Active Management:  Pick up contracts, customize your rig, make crucial choices when events pop up and socialize with people on roadside stops or take a few pictures.     Passive Simulation:  Keep the truck alongside your desktop while you focus on your real-world tasks. Your mileage accumulates, day transitions smoothly into night, and weather shifts as the journey continues.       Put on your favorite cassette, grab a hot mug of coffee, and let the road keep you company.

name: Lucky Dog Rise
lang: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Danish, Indonesian, Norwegian, Swedish, Dutch, Vietnamese, Malay, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Portugal, Icelandic, Ukrainian, Russian
short: Bring a lucky dog to your desktop! It stays in a screen corner, keeps you company while you work, and lets a little luck into your day. Take a break with a quick card game, win rewards, open blind boxes, collect outfits, and make your desktop a lucky nook for you and your pup!
about: Maybe you have already kept cats, fish, tiny bugs, or all kinds of curious little companions on your desktop. This time, the one staying by your side is a dog.          Lucky Dog Rise   is a warm and relaxing desktop pet game. You can bring a little dog to your desktop, where it stays in a corner of your screen and keeps you company while you work, take a break, or play games, letting a little luck slip into your everyday routine. Meeting you is the luckiest thing that ever happened to this pup. That is why it is called Lucky Dog.    It will not get in your way or nag you to do anything. It simply stays there, watching you finish one small task after another, cheering you on in its own little ways. When you play other fullscreen games, it can step aside for a while and leave your screen space to the battle ahead.       While you focus on your work, every keystroke and every mouse click gradually builds up Lucky Points. Your everyday actions are no longer just typing and clicking. They become part of your dog's growth and rewards.      When you want to relax, switch to card mode and play a light poker-style mini game with your dog. Choose which cards to keep, draw new ones, and earn more Lucky Points through a little judgment, a little luck, and the quiet bond between you and your pup.      Use Lucky Points to get new blind boxes, collect outfits, items, and fresh looks. Make the desktop dog who has always stayed by your side cuter, more special, and more truly your own companion.      "Busy days come apart at the edges. A little dog stitches them back together."       Leave a spot for this little dog on your busy desktop.                   All in all, if you enjoy desktop companion games like Bongo Cat — or have ever wished for something like Bongo Cat, but with a dog — Lucky Dog Rise might be just what you’re looking for. It’s a cute dog desktop pet game where a little puppy can stay by your side, hang out near your taskbar, and keep you company while you type, click, work, or play. Inspired by the charm of Shiba Inu dogs, Doge-style internet culture, and even the playful idea of a Menswear Dog, Lucky Dog Rise lets you collect different hats and outfits, dress up your dog, and turn your desktop companion into a look that feels truly your own. Whether you’re looking for a puppy on your desktop, a Shiba Inu desktop pet, a Doge-like dog companion, a dog on your taskbar, a dog with hats, or simply a cozy desktop dog game to leave running in the background, Lucky Dog Rise is made to be your little everyday companion.

Not every item is tradable, but your next rare drop could be the one you've been hunting for.           YOUR DESKTOP. YOUR PACE.   Leave your fighter battling while you focus on other things. name: Gunfire & Magic - Desktop Co-op Extraction!
lang: English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Traditional Chinese, Vietnamese
short: A co-op idle minimalist desktop extraction game you can play with friends! In a city destroyed by a strange force, many factions covet advanced science and magic—and you step into this land of opportunity. Fight, search, extract, grow stronger, build your camp, and uncover your origins!
about: This is a " co-op idle " " minimalist desktop extraction " game you can play with friends!       Gameplay    A " co-op minimalist extraction " game that sits on your desktop.    Apocalypse, looting, survival, extraction—sound hardcore? In this game,  almost everything runs on its own .    Gear up and teleport out from base! Your character automatically  fights, searches, and picks up supplies .    You only decide:  push deeper and loot more, or quit while you're ahead and extract?  After all,  only what you bring back alive is truly yours!     After a successful extract, stash the loot in the  warehouse , strengthen your character, upgrade your devices, and expand the base for the next run.    As the base grows, unlock more  buildings  and recruit all kinds of  NPCs , until the quiet little outpost comes alive.    Take quests, push the story, and with every run search for the truth of this world and your own origins.     Head out and loot. Extract alive. Come home and build. Then go gamble again with a better stash.       Free Trading     Some items produced in the game can be traded freely on the Steam Market !    To keep the market and other online features stable, we will  strictly ban cheaters !    More  new gameplay systems  that  take part in Steam Market trading  are on the way!      The Beginning of the Story...  In the City of Dawn of human civilization— Dawn City —the event known as " Doomsday of Dawn " took place.  This vast modern metropolis gathered most of the world's cutting-edge technology and top magic corporations, then fell overnight to a mysterious force.  Governments stayed silent, and factions that coveted the place moved in, turning yesterday's prosperous city into a dangerous land of mysteries and opportunities.  You and your little assistant start from Dawn City. On a continent of  modern technology ,  magic , and  gods , fight, search, and extract as any  class  you like. Grow stronger, build your camp, recruit more companions, and set out to uncover your origins!  "Don't worry! This mission will go as smoothly as always, meow!"      Update Plan  Plenty of updates are planned:  life professions , an  open-world hub city ,  world boss hunts ,  PvP ,  GvG guild wars , more  social play , character  appearance customization ,  skins ,  pets , maps with  more gameplay  and  story , more  base-building , and much more!  After launch, the game will keep a  weekly update  pace!  We will also listen to players and add what the community most wants to play into later update plans!     Wishlist Now!

about: Every game you play deserves a better companion than a dozen browser tabs. Gamepan is a companion app for every game you play. Give each game its own workspace, then fill it with exactly the tools you need: a checklist for quests, a map with your own pins, a tracker for the grind, a timer for resets, a notepad for that one boss strategy. Drag them anywhere on a free-form canvas, size them how you like, or hit  Arrange  and let Gamepan lay them out for you.  No ads interrupting you. No subscription draining your wallet every month. No account to make, no login to forget. You buy it once, it runs on your PC, and everything you make stays on your machine. One workspace, every game Build a layout that fits how  you  play, with unlimited tabs and modules, grouped into collapsible categories to keep big setups tidy. Whether it's an extraction shooter, a roguelike, a sprawling RPG, an MMO grind or a cozy farming sim, Gamepan adapts to the game, not the other way around.  And it isn't just for video games. It's great for  tabletop RPGs , too. Keep your campaign map, NPCs, loot, quest log and session journal in one place, then pull them up at the table on a phone or tablet with view-only sharing. 24 modules, mix and match Drop in exactly what a game needs:    Checklist and Kanban board:  quests, dailies, achievement hunts and long-term goals    Farming Tracker:  grind goals with checklist progress toward what you need    Map / Pins:  your own map images with pins, zones, categories and labels, from a small sketch to a huge world map    Items, Builds and Collection:  a catalog of your gear, loadouts with item links, and completion tracking    Crafting Calculator:  pick what to make and get the raw-material list, the in-between crafts and the total cost    Table, Stats and Counters:  gear, mats, NPCs, currency, deaths, runs, anything with a number    Timers and Calendar:  resets, respawns and raid nights, with alerts    Skill Tree:  plan talent and tech trees with prerequisites and a point budget    Notes and Session journal:  rich text, images, and a running diary of your sessions    Dashboard and Activity Log:  a live overview of everything, and a history of your changes    Spin the wheel, Dice roller and Coin flip:  let fate pick your next run, build or challenge    Whiteboard, Gallery and Links:  annotate screenshots, keep albums, and save your wikis and guides   Maps that are actually yours Upload any map image and make it useful: drop pins, draw zones, sort everything into color-coded categories, and filter what you see. Labels stay readable as you zoom, and big maps stay smooth. Use it for extraction routes, hidden collectibles, a dungeon you're mapping by hand, or the world of your D&D campaign. A companion that shows up A floating  overlay  keeps your modules on top of your game, live and interactive, so you can tick off a quest or check a map without alt-tabbing. Set its opacity, pick which modules it shows, and let Gamepan  auto-detect  when a game you've set up starts and open its overlay for you. Share it on the Steam Workshop Built something good? Put it on the Workshop and let other players use it. Publish a whole workspace, a single module or a map set, then browse, subscribe and import what everyone else has made, all without leaving the app. Publishing stays Private until you choose otherwise, and imported items go through a one-click safety review, so nothing loads unseen. Yours, and private Gamepan is  local-first . It has no account system and no tracking of any kind. Your workspaces live on your PC as plain files you fully control, so you can export them, back them up or wipe them anytime.  Sharing setups is safe, too. When you import a workspace from someone else, its images and links stay hidden behind a one-click review, so nothing unexpected loads until you say so. Anything you add yourself always shows. Share to the couch, on your terms Turn on optional  local-network sharing  to mirror any module, view-on

about: Find a peaceful oasis for your weary eyes amidst a busy day of work or study.   Nano Reef  is a cozy, casual game that transforms every click and keystroke into a beautiful marine ecosystem. Requiring no intense focus, it sits quietly in the corner of your screen, growing silently while you are busy and keeping you company when you need a break. And now, this tiny ocean is no longer yours alone.    ⌨️ Type to Grow Your Reef  Whether you are coding, writing reports, typing, or clicking around, every action quietly earns you gold.  The game runs gently at the edge of your desktop and never gets in the way of your work.  Look up, and your little reef has already saved up a small fortune.  🤝 Keep Fish with Friends     Friend Rooms : Create a room and invite friends through Steam. Up to 8 people can gather around one aquarium, each bringing a fish of their own.     Fish Trading : Swap fish, corals, and your handmade fish and decorations with friends, and bring your favorite tank mates home.    🎨 Draw a Fish That's All Yours  Paint with the built-in canvas or upload your own images to create one-of-a-kind fish and decorations for your tank. name: MONji
lang: English
short: A virtual companion that lives on your desktop and shares your clock. MONjis grow in real time, from an egg to a grown-up adult shaped by time-based events and small choices. Explore new places, loot parts and craft unique visual mods for your device to show your personality. MONji grows on you !
about: A DESKTOP VIRTUAL COMPANION   Place your MONji device in the corner of your screen and let it live alongside you while you work, watch videos, draw, or play.    In a world built around fast and endless stimulation, MONji is a slower experience. A small creature growing over time, simply sharing your space.           RANDOM EVENTS AND STYLES           Your MONji grows from what it  experiences .     Random events  will happen to your MONji, and if you decide to interact with them, they will gain  Style Points (SP)  based on the nature of the situation.     There are 5 different styles:     Cheerful      Cool      Cute      Wise      Shy       These  styles  shape your MONji’s  personality  and will determine their  future evolutions  !         EVENTS BASED ON TIME, PLACE, AND LIFE STAGE   A peaceful sunrise. A strange encounter late at night. A childhood memory that returns years later.    Your MONji experiences different events depending on the time of day, the places it visits, and its stage of evolution.    As it grows, its world grows with it !     A COMPANION THAT REMEMBERS   Your MONji remembers the moments it shared with you.  Certain memories, locations, or past encounters may unlock rare future events once your MONji becomes older.  The way you raise it quietly shapes the creature it becomes.     EXPLORE THE MONji WORLD   While you’re busy, your MONji isn’t.  Send it on explorations to discover new places, encounter unique events, and collect rare parts.  Every area contains different loot just for you to be discovered...               CRAFT AND CUSTOMISE   Use what it finds to craft a wide range of visual mods for your MONji device.  Mix styles, materials, and aesthetics to shape your device into something that feels right for you.   Or strange. Both work !             TAKE CARE   Feed it. Let it rest. Keep it somewhat clean.    Neglect your MONji for too long and it may become sick… or disappear entirely.  But no worry — just start over, that's the privilege of being digital.               CHROMA MONjis (THEY EXIST!)   Some MONjis hatch… differently.  Brighter colors.   Little sparkles.   Slightly suspicious aura.    They’re rare and possibly special, no one’s completely sure...

about: Keep a small battle window on your desktop and let your knight keep hunting while you work, study, or browse.  LordRise  is a desktop idle RPG where every hunt brings back equipment, spellbooks, and materials that make your knight a little stronger.  Hunt Through 10,000 Stages  Push through the stages of 400 regions and defeat a boss every five stages. Decide for yourself whether to keep farming at your current stage or keep advancing to higher ones.  Loot It, Then Enhance It   Equipment drops as individual items. Compare, lock, and equip pieces to find the setup that works for you.   Enhance your favorite gear from +0 to +10. A failed attempt never lowers the enhancement level.   Gear becomes bound when you equip it or enhance it successfully, and pieces that reach +10 can be registered in your collection for permanent stat bonuses.   Craft accessories from gold and accessories of the same grade.   Grow Your Magic with Spellbooks  Spellbooks drop in four grades. Title Challenge  Separate from hunting, Title Challenge lets you climb from the lowest noble title all the way to first place in the Myth rank. More to Conquer  Dungeons, the Tower of Challenge, raids, world bosses, duels, Bloodbound guilds, and your own Territory open up as you grow stronger. So — what will your pumpkin grow into?

name: Kipple
lang: English
short: Your PC can dream. A free desktop companion that lives in your Windows, blinks, reacts and chats with you. Explore a diversity of unique creatures dreamed by your own machine: hybrids, elementals and rare creatures. Each one is one of a kind and can be exchanged at the Steam Market.
about: Somewhere in your computer, there is a creature nobody has met yet.   Kipple is a cosy desktop companion and creature collector for Windows. A little creature lives in a transparent, always-on-top window while you work, play or stare meaningfully at a spreadsheet. Your PC dreams its artwork locally, giving a small life its own appearance and personality.  It blinks. It reacts to a pet. It chats when you feel like company, remembers things you tell it, and counts electric sheep when it sleeps. Move it to a quiet corner, resize it, or let it take up rather more of your desk than you intended. A familiar creature. An unexpected combination.  Meet cute animals and unusual hybrids: a Foxguin, a Bunfrog, a Rambear, or another surprising little combination. Colours, silhouettes and expressions give your collection its character. Discover elemental Kipples with fire, ice, electric and earth effects that move around your companion.  Common, Rare, Pixel, Glitch, Mythic and Legendary are six visual tiers. Pixel creatures have a crisp sprite treatment; other rarities bring their own card styles and effects. Rarity changes the look, not competitive power. There is no PvP or power leaderboard. A little company, on your terms    Pet, chat with, move and resize your desktop companion.   Keep a collection and choose which Kipple joins you on the desktop.   Receive free drops while you play: Kipples, paints and boosters (details below).   Adjust text size and motion settings to make your companion comfortable to live with.   Your collection goes with Steam  Approved Kipples become persistent Steam inventory items, each with its own card showing the creature. Cards are still images; a Dream Reel animates one. Equipping a Kipple does not consume it: owning the item is owning the creature.  Keep your favourites or list eligible Kipples on the Steam Community Market. When one is sold, that creature moves to its new owner. Kipples, paints, boosters and Dream Reels use the Market rather than direct trades or gifting. Market access, holds and eligibility follow Steam's rules; availability and sale value are not guaranteed. Drops while you play  Kipple is free. While the game is open and signed in to Steam, your PC dreams drops: your first Kipple right away, then one drop every 12 hours of play. Pat, chat or emote with your Kipple once in each 3 hours of play and a drop takes 9 hours instead. Kipple's server counts the play time, up to 12 hours a day; time with the game closed does not count, and a ready drop waits until you claim it.  Each drop is a Kipple (20%), a paint (40%) or an item (40%):   Kipples: Common 92.89%, Rare 5%, Pixel 1%, Glitch 1%, Mythic 0.1%, Legendary 0.01%. 12% of Kipples carry an element: fire, electric, ice or earth, 3% each.   Paints: one of 372 colours and greys, each equally likely. A paint recolours a Kipple and is used up when applied; you see a preview first.   Items: Dream Incubator 64%, Dream Beacon 10%, Rarity Prism 10%, Element Spark 10%, Lucid Beacon 4%, Kipple Beacon 1%, Dream Reel 1%.   Boosters, Dream Reels and Fuse  Boosters are single-use Steam items that change your next drop:   Dream Incubator: takes 3 hours off the current drop.   Dream Beacon and Lucid Beacon: the next drop is a Kipple at least 50% or 75% of the time.   Kipple Beacon: the next drop is a Kipple; its rarity and element stay random.   Rarity Prism: doubles the chance of a non-Common Kipple on the next drop (7.11% to 14.22%).   Element Spark: doubles the chance of an element on the next drop (12% to 24%).  Different boosters combine, once each per drop. All activated boosters are spent on the next drop, even when it turns out to be a paint or an item.  A Dream Reel gives one of your Kipples an animated Steam card. The Kipple is re-made as an animated item: same creature, new card.  Fuse erases two of your Kipples for good (their Steam items are consumed) and gives you one random item from the item list above, with the same odds, shown before yo

name: My Desktop Dwarf: Taskbar Forge
lang: English, Polish, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Ukrainian, Turkish, Traditional Chinese, Czech, Indonesian, Portuguese - Brazil, Thai, Vietnamese, Hungarian
short: Brokk has set up a tiny forge just above your taskbar. You tap the keys, he swings the hammer. Mostly it is horseshoes or kettles, sometimes a legendary sword. Brygida sells it all in their shop. You type, he smiths. Together, the work goes faster and feels better.
about: YOU TYPE. HE FORGES. Brokk lives just above your taskbar, where he runs a forge and works whenever you do. You write emails or code, and he forges items. Every key you press brings his hammer down. When you type quickly, the furnace glows white-hot and Brokk gives it his all. When you take a break, he catches his breath too. A FORGE THAT KEEPS YOU GOING WITHOUT GETTING IN THE WAY The game is designed to stay out of the way while you work. Typing fuels the forge, and Brokk keeps pace with you. Open the panel when you want to buy an upgrade or check on the shop, then get back to what you were doing. You can move the forge, resize it, tone down the effects or turn off the sound. LEGENDS ARE FORGED FROM ORE It starts with ore, then ingots hammered out one by one, and finally a finished piece: a dagger, a cauldron, a horseshoe or whatever the shop's customers have ordered. Sometimes the metal gleams and something legendary takes shape: Szczerbiec. Excalibur. Mjolnir. There are 49 item patterns across five rarity levels. You can browse your collection in the display cabinet.          From everyday tools to legendary mithril treasures.  HIS WIFE BRYGIDA RUNS THE SHOP    Brygida sells whatever comes off the anvil. Some customers buy what's on the shelves. Others place special orders and pay extra. You decide how freely the forge spends on ore for new items, from inexpensive copper to the best metal you can afford.         THE FORGE PAYS FOR ITS OWN UPGRADES The gold you earn goes back into the forge and shop. Buy Brokk a heavier hammer or better bellows, and Brygida a new sign to bring in more customers. A whetstone improves your chances of forging rarer pieces, while counter decorations raise prices in the shop. You can speed up forging, increase earnings or save up for the next metal. Just leave some gold for ore.  As your equipment improves, the little workshop changes with it. You can also give the forge a different look by choosing a workshop style.         FROM COPPER TO MITHRIL Start with copper, then unlock bronze and iron. Keep building up your forge to work with steel, silver, gold and finally mithril. Each new metal gives you another reason to get back to the anvil, fill your collection and invest in your workshop. TRY THE FREE DEMO The demo lets you forge with copper, bronze and iron. If you choose, you can carry over your collection, forge and shop upgrades, and gathered resources when the full game is released.  Add My Desktop Dwarf: Taskbar Forge to your wishlist and follow the game to keep up with the forge.   Privacy:  The game counts key and mouse-button presses. It does not record the text you type. Gameplay works offline.

short: A cozy idle aquarium that lives at the bottom of your screen - the kind you can reach into. Grab fish, toss them, collect them, and let a little ocean keep you company while you work, study or chill.
about: A little ocean that lives at the bottom of your screen.   Still Waters is a cozy idle aquarium that takes up residence at the bottom of your screen.  While you work, study, watch, game, doomscroll, or do absolutely nothing.  A small, living strip of water with fish, plants, and a quiet little ecosystem going about its day.  You can ignore it for hours and come back to find your fish thriving...  Or you can reach in and stir things up.   The aquarium you can actually reach into.   You know how, in real life, sticking your arm into an aquarium is generally frowned upon? Not here.    Grab any fish and drag it wherever you like    Toss them into the air and skim them across the surface    Collide them. Airborne fish bounce off each other and anything else that’s flying around    Make waves across the surface. Stir up sand from the floor.       Feed them by hand. They'll chase your cursor, sometimes leaping clean out of the water for a bite.    Toss them a beach ball. Drop an anchor. Rip kelp straight out of the seabed and spin it around like a windmill.  You decide how chaotic or chill it gets.   Somewhere new to drift.   Sunlit streams. Golden koi ponds. Tropical reefs bursting with color.   Frozen arctic waters. The depths below.  Each one with its own creatures and its own mood.  New places to discover as you go.    Fill your Fishipedia.   Some fish drift. Some dart. Some hide. Some hunt.   A growing roster of creatures to discover and collect - each with their own behaviors, moods, and quirks. Some traits come down to species. Some are just luck of the draw.  Buy eggs and wait to see what hatches...  Buy more of the fish you've already discovered...  Or create your own custom morphs and put something in the water that nobody else has.    No one expects you to oversee these waters alone.   You'll have a furry friend keeping you company.  Pet them. name: Ripple Lane 101 : Moments With You
lang: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese*, Korean, Traditional Chinese**
short: Share quiet campus dorm life with Yiling in an idle companion game. Focus with a Pomodoro timer, track plans and ideas, relax to Lofi and white noise, and choose outfits and decor. Explore her future world through stories fully voiced in Chinese, and uncover secrets about yourself.
about: It's 2146. Yiling, a girl from New Shanghai, has just moved into her dorm at the Jiutian Institute of Interstellar Navigation.  She's about to learn how to cross the vast distances between the stars. For now, though, she has more pressing things to figure out: keeping up with classes, making new friends, and deciding what time to go to bed tonight.  You'll be her companion through afternoons made for daydreaming and nights that call for a little more effort. Listen to her stories of campus life in the future, remember the names she often mentions, and begin to discover her world from one small dorm room.  Interstellar travel takes careful planning. Spending time with her doesn't.  Bring whatever you'd like to do today. Or simply stay a while.          An Endless Cycle of Rotation   Every planet has its own days and nights.     Like you, Yiling has plans of her own. Sometimes she studies, sometimes she rests, and sometimes she'd rather leave unfinished things until tomorrow. You can join her rhythm or each keep your own. As the days pass, new stories and little changes gradually find their way into this small dorm room.  Experience accumulates while the game is running. Every focus session, yours or hers, contributes to her growth, gradually unlocking new story scenes and room decorations. There's no need for constant interaction. Spend time with her at your own pace, and let companionship become part of your everyday life.          Traces Through Spacetime, Never Forgotten   Time spent with care, and ideas that arrive in a flash, deserve to be remembered.     Break distant goals into little things you can do today. Give your habits a little time, and your ideas somewhere to land. You and Yiling can make plans and find your way forward, one day at a time.  The Pomodoro timer, planning panel, and idea notes help you make time to focus and put your thoughts in order. Use Pomodoro sessions to make progress on goals, to-dos, and habits, or mark them complete yourself. The calendar keeps a history of your progress and ideas, with the option to export your records. Your efforts deserve to be preserved.            The Universe's Gently Shifting Frequencies   Sometimes, a little sound makes the world feel quieter.     Fill the background with rain among the high-rises at night, or the sounds of a summer classroom. Add a melody in no particular hurry. Whether you're focusing on something or simply daydreaming with Yiling, there's a sound to keep you company as the time goes by.  Find your rhythm with Lofi music and ambient themes spanning synthetic sounds, nature, and everyday life. From synthetic noise in its many colors to streams, coastlines, and a winter hearth, each theme offers sounds you can mix and adjust, with subtle variations that keep unfolding. You're changing more than the volume: a breeze might pass now and then, or return in gust after gust. Let the world around you sound just the way you like it.            Distant Starlight, Drawing Closer   The shape of an era can be found in one person's everyday life.     Worries about class, funny stories between friends, a name mentioned in passing: each offers a glimpse of 2146. You'll meet new people alongside Yiling and gradually discover the wider world beyond her dorm. Those casual conversations also hold clues to another question: who, exactly, are you in her world?  The story moves forward as Yiling grows, with further updates to come after launch. Full Chinese voice acting, precise lip sync, and nuanced facial animation bring her words and emotions to life, letting you hear the smile in her voice and see the hesitation she leaves unspoken.            An Ideal Space, All Your Own   One dorm room can hold so many different moods.     Let the light of a clear afternoon linger, or bring a rainy night to the window. Pick an outfit for Yiling, add a few new decorations, and shape everyday life into something you love, little by little.  Choose the time of day and weather
