short: A multi-copy/paste tool that stores clipboard history (text/images) and pastes sequentially via Ctrl+\. Features a customizable cartoon assistant, pause/reset controls, and near-zero resource usage.
about: This is a multi-copy, single-paste utility tool designed to streamline your workflow. It allows users to copy text, images, or screenshots via  Ctrl+C , right-click copy, or other methods, while the software records all copied content. When you need to paste multiple copied items in sequence, simply press  Ctrl+\  (either left/right  Ctrl  key +  \ ,  \ is the key above  Enter ) to paste stored content in recorded order.   Key Features:  ◆  Clipboard History Timeline  A row of small dots at the bottom visually represents your clipboard history. The  purple dot  indicates the current position for pasting. Click any dot to start pasting from that specific entry, and the dot will turn to purple (e.g., skip earlier items).  ◆  Enhanced Pasting      Ctrl+\ : Pastes stored items  sequentially  from your chosen starting point.     Ctrl+V : Pastes the  latest copied item  (default shortcut won't be blocked).    ◆  Customizable Cartoon Companion  Interact with the "Copy-Paste Girl" character:    Adjust her size via  mouse wheel scroll  or  touchpad gestures .    Drag her freely to any screen position.    Replace her appearance by modifying  image.png  in the root folder.    ◆  Lightweight & Flexible Control      Pause/Resume : Click the  Pause button  to temporarily stop recording new clipboard content.     Instant Reset : Press the  R button  to clear all stored history (all dots will be cleaned) and reset the software.    Minimal system resource usage – runs quietly and acts as a cute desktop pet with minimal computer hardware  requirements and minimal resource consumption.

Use the Flamethrower, Exorcist Camera, "Farewell" Cannon, and Fireball to keep the swarm under control. name: Bug Bounty Hunter --Idle
lang: English
short: An idle hacking sim where you scan for real vulnerabilities, automate your tools, and manage CPU, RAM, and heat before your machine crashes. Climb bounty programs, deploy to the cloud, and build a satirical hacking career from your terminal.
about: You're not a hacker. You're a  professional .  Bug Bounty Hunter --Idle puts you behind a terminal, hunting nine real vulnerability classes, from IDOR and XSS up through RCE, supply chain compromise and cloud misconfiguration, for cash, reputation, and the dubious glory of a corporate bug bounty program. Manually scan for exploits, or automate the whole operation and watch the payouts roll in while your CPU quietly cooks itself.  It's an idle game built like an operating system: draggable windows, a real terminal with typed commands and easter eggs, a package manager for your tools, and a process monitor that isn't just for show - every scanner you run costs real CPU, RAM, and heat, and pushing too hard crashes your rig.   Features:      Hunt real vulnerabilities.  Nine vuln classes, each with a working exploit example and a fix, taught through an in-game wiki - actually learn something while you idle.     Automate everything.  Eleven tools to buy, deploy to the cloud, and eventually an auto-clicker that scans for you - but only while you're watching it, because a click that fires when you're not paying attention isn't really automation, it's a bug. One scanner rewards breadth instead of depth: Nuclei Templates gets stronger for every vulnerability class you have ever discovered, so going wide finally pays.     Manage your rig, not just your money.  CPU load, RAM, and heat are real constraints. Overclock too hard and you  will  crash, with a full BSOD to prove it.     Climb the bounty programs.  Reputation unlocks harder, better-paying targets, up to Gov/Defense contracts paying fifteen times base. Prestige resets your career for permanent multipliers when you're ready to go legit, or go bigger.     Stop being a one-person operation.  Hire and level up Junior Hunters, collect Contract Fees every engagement, and spend them on upgrades only your firm can buy. They keep finding bugs whether you're clicking or not.     Train like it's your job.  Pass code review challenges on real vulnerable snippets, and run tabletop incident-response exercises with a recurring cast of coworkers who remember you engagement after engagement: an exhausted CISO, a rival hunter who's always six minutes ahead, a compliance officer who files everything in triplicate, and a support bot with no bedside manner. They show up in your reports, your inbox, and your incident calls.     An inbox worth opening.  mail.sh delivers career milestones, reward attachments, and your daily contract, sorted into folders, because even a bug bounty hunter deserves an organized inbox.     Timed challenges, daily contracts, and achievements  for players who want more than a number going up, including runs that test how disciplined you can be with automation switched on. Watch the findings ticker, too: an anonymous tip occasionally scrolls past, and catching it in time turns one lead into a cascade of findings.     Bonus diversions when you need a break from bugs.  A Minesweeper-flavored network scanner, a Snake-flavored worm simulator, a Breakout-flavored WAF-buster, a Pipe Dream-flavored proxy-chain router, and a desktop pet that celebrates your wins and mourns your losses right alongside you.     A terminal worth typing into.  Hidden commands, dry hacker-culture humor, an original soundtrack, a desktop you can retheme and rewallpaper, and an OS-simulation aesthetic that doesn't take itself too seriously, even when your CPU is on fire.

name: 摸鱼悟道
lang: Simplified Chinese
short: In a fading age, heaven's qi survives only when you slip free of work. A desktop pet idle Xianxia game—your little cultivator reacts to foreground apps. Word & Excel seal qi; games, chat & video restore it. Spirit roots, eight realms, sigils & talismans. App names only—local data.
about: You Slack, They Cultivate   In the corner of your screen sits a tiny Q-version cultivator.  They don’t farm mobs or clear dungeons. They watch  whatever app is in the foreground :     Work & study apps  → qi sealed, black chains of KPIs     Games, chat, video & fun  → normal cultivation, green light flowing     Unlisted / gray apps  → slow gains, fate unclear     Retreat mode  (game minimized) → faster qi, do not disturb     Long AFK  → drifting in the void, gains fade until you return    The moment you leave Word for something leisure—the pet opens their eyes, chains snap, and for a few seconds qi surges:  “The dust of the world is cut; qi floods for three breaths.”   That’s the core loop of  Mo Yu Wu Dao  ( Slack to Cultivate ):  every app switch is a moment of practice.    A Thought at Your Desk Can Become the Way    Your cultivation isn’t built on meditation cushions—it’s built on  what’s on your screen .   Your elixir isn’t rare herbs—it’s  every paid minute of the day .   In a fading age, heaven has collapsed and qi runs dry. Only in moments when you slip free of mundane duty can you steal a thread of fate. You are a modern cultivator living inside a screen. Between work and leisure you gather qi, nurture  five spirit roots , and climb from  Qi Refinement  to  Ascension . KPIs are inner demons. Deadlines are heavenly tribulations. Ascension—well, that might be retirement.   Heart Mirror · Local Sensing, Zero Privacy Risk   The in-game  Heart Mirror  reads your foreground app’s  exe name once per second  to decide cultivation state.  We  do not  read window titles, web page content, documents, memory, or network data. The  Process Ledger  and all saves stay  on your machine only —nothing is uploaded.  On first launch you see a full explanation. Prefer not to auto-detect? Switch to  pure manual mode  and toggle “Enter the World” / “Leave the World” yourself—you can still play everything.  Browsers are the grayest zone: pick a default strategy (work / leisure / gray), or install the optional  browser extension  for  domain-level  sorting—GitHub as work, video sites as leisure, your call.   Five Spirit Roots · Five Ways to Slack   All five roots exist from the start. Spend qi to level them— spent qi still counts toward realm progress , so upgrading never slows breakthrough.   | Root | Role | Effect |    | Metal |  Burst  |  Higher qi surge when switching from work to leisure  |    | Wood |  Steady  |  Bonus to all positive-gain states  |    | Water |  Gray zone  |  Better gains from unlisted apps & browsers  |    | Fire |  Serendipity  |  Chance for “Sudden Insight”—bonus qi & fate  |    | Earth |  Retreat  |  Stronger retreat multiplier, more stable when mind wavers  |   Metal sword cultivator, wood alchemist, water wanderer, fire acolyte, earth anchor—pick your path.   Star Gazing · Talismans in Your Fate Plate   Breakthroughs grant  Fate , spent to  gaze at the stars  and draw  Star Talismans —equippable passives like  Payroll Flying Sword ,  Jade Half-Leisure Calendar , and  Star River Enters Fate  (22 in the first pool).  Duplicates become  Stardust , traded for specific rare talismans. Fate plate slots unlock with realm—up to  7 slots —so you can build your own slack build.   Sigil Casting · Your Mouse Is the Brush   Turn on sigil mode and draw with your cursor:     ○ Qi Gathering  — short-term qi rate boost     △ Spirit Summon  — clickable spirit stones for a qi burst     × Slash Demon  — clear one “Unstable Mind” debuff     □ Return to Origin  — instant large qi gain     ↯ Star Draw  — gain Fate    Successful casts wrap the pet in sigil light. Higher realms unlock more sigils.   Dao Forms · One Cultivator, Many Faces    Dao Forms  are your pet’s look and temperament—the same cultivator, different sides of the path:     Office Drifter  (default) — badge, floating to-do talismans,  Performance Demon Record ; peak workplace humor     Slacking Sword Cultivator  — carries a “payroll flying sword”; unlock

name: Tiny Pet Salon
lang: English
short: A small first-person pet grooming game. Muddy pets line up outside your salon. Wash them, dry them, brush them, clip their nails and pick out a bow or a party hat. Hand them back and they rate your work. You can even keep the salon open in a corner of your screen while you do other things.
about: Tiny Pet Salon is a small pet grooming game you play in first person. Pets turn up at your window covered in mud. Carry each one to the bathtub, then to the grooming table, and do every job yourself, up close. When you're done, hand it back through the window and it rates your work out of five paws.    Grooming, by hand  Rub the sponge over every patch of mud until it's gone, then rinse the soap off with the sprayer. Dry the fur with a towel or the hair dryer and watch it puff up, brush it until it shines, and clip the nails on each paw. Turn the pet around to get at its back.            Bows, bandanas and party hats  Every pet comes with an order ticket that says what it wants: which jobs, which shampoo scent, which color. Finish with a bow, a bandana or a party hat, and put it wherever you click.            Pets with personality  Ticklish pets wiggle around while you work. Pets that hate water might jump out of the tub and run. Some show up extra muddy, and the fluffy ones need twice the brushing but tip more. A dog biscuit from the treat jar calms anyone down.    Make the salon yours  Spend your tips on better gear, like a faster sprayer, a hair dryer and a rubber duck that keeps nervous pets in the bath, and on decor that turns up through the season, from a ducky parade and party bunting to twinkling fairy lights, a fish tank and a fountain for the front yard. Happy customers come back as regulars, often asking for the same look as last time, and their photos go up on your wall. And when it's quiet, give Nori, the salon's little black cat, a pet. She purrs.    A little town outside your window  Your salon sits on a sunny corner: cars pull up at the crossing to let pets cross, neighbors stroll by with their friends, chimneys puff, butterflies drift over the flower boxes, and every window looks out on gardens, shops and the park across the road.            Twenty days, two Pet Shows  Each day brings something to look forward to, like brushes, bows, scented shampoos, nail trims, a hat parade, dress-up days and big rushes, along with a goal that pays a bonus. Halfway through it's the Summer Pet Show, and on day twenty the Grand Pet Show, where the day's ratings win you a medal and a rosette for your wall. After that, the salon stays open as long as you like, and the Pet Show comes back every few days for another go at gold.            Three ways to play     Relax:  no timer. Pets come in one at a time and wait as long as you need.     Frenetic:  a line forms outside and pets get impatient, but every groom pays 30% more.     Desktop:  the salon shrinks into a small window in the corner of your screen. Every few minutes a pet rings the bell, and you click to open up.      Features    11 kinds of pets, from puppies and bunnies to a polar bear and a tiger    Wash, rinse, dry, brush, clip nails and dress up, all done by hand    Bows, bandanas and party hats in three colors, and three shampoo scents    Pets with personalities, regular customers and a photo wall    Upgrades and decor to buy with your tips, from party bunting to a fish tank    A 20-day season with daily goals and two Pet Shows, then free play    A lively little town outside every window, and a salon cat to pet    Full controller support, with a layout that fits the Steam Deck    19 achievements

name: Otherworldly Business
lang: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
short: An action RPG set in an anime-styled otherworld. Play an adventurer who crossed over from the real world and take contracts to hunt goblins. World travel unlocks mid-to-late game, opening the West, the post-apocalypse, elven territory and more.
about: Otherworldly Business is an action RPG with an anime-styled otherworld setting.  As a career professional living in the real world, with no warning at all, you discover a way into another world inside a computer program. After entering the otherworld, you learn the real reason behind it, along with the mysterious passages formed by countless collapsed and intersecting parallel universes. You will travel between different prime universes to complete contracts, and return to your own real world with the earnings and the loot.         Open World The otherworld's prime universe is one seamless open world — the mainland, harbors and islands are all connected, and you can set out from the village and explore freely. Wildlife roams in herds and packs around their own habitats, monster nests and strongholds are scattered across the wilds, and goblin warbands patrol and scout the roads. Every trip out brings something different!         Combat A soulslike-leaning combat system, but with a lighter overall style. Anime-style animation plus realistic physical feel, the interplay of combo chains, and a spell and weapon switching system will deliver a highly satisfying sense of impact plus the fun of loot hunting! And you'll unlock even more playable combat stances as you progress!                 Beyond fighting on land, you can also take a warship out to sea and battle enemies in naval combat. Hulls and ship parts can be freely swapped and customised!                Classes and Weapons Four playable classes during the demo: Knight, Warrior, Mage, Archer. After full release, you can unlock different class combat stances as you play, such as the "Spellblade", combinable "Dual Blades", and the "Spear".  Weapon types include sword and shield, greatsword, axe, hammer, bow, staff and spellbook. Different weapons vary in reach, attack speed and recovery — every class is worth experiencing yourself!         Mounts and Flight Gallop across the open world on horseback, or mount a griffin or pegasus and soar freely through the sky, looking down over the whole continent! Defeated beasts have a chance to drop summoning stones — wolves, bears, tigers and many other beasts can become your mounts, and rare variants even glow. World Travel You will gradually unlock the ability to travel between otherworlds. about: A little skatepark for the bottom of your screen.   Remember when your desktop felt like a place? Desktop Halfpipe brings that vibe back. A tiny rider carves a halfpipe along the edge of your screen while you work, browse, game, or stream. Glance down and they're mid-air. Stay a minute and chase a high score. Or let them ride on their own and just enjoy the company.  It's cozy, it's quiet, and it never asks for your whole screen.           Pick Your Ride   Skateboard, inline skates, BMX, scooter, snowboard, or skis. Switch any time from the tray. Every rider knows every trick, they just call them different things. A skater's Double Kickflip is a BMX rider's Double Tailwhip.   Easy to Learn, Fun to Master     Carve the pipe with A / D or ← →    Catch air, pull tricks, and chain them into combos    Land Ollies and Kickflips on the ground    Chase your personal best and 16 Steam Achievements    No skill trees, no grind. Just ride, trick, land, repeat. And if you'd rather not keep score at all, Cozy Mode means a bail never costs you a thing.   Take It to the Street   When you want a change of scenery, roll out to the street or down the hill. Smash through Rampage, weave the Slalom gates, or play a game of S-K-A-T-E against one of the town's guild kids.           The Town Next Door   Just past the pipe is Standstillville, a small town that's always glad to see you. Stop by the Plaza, join one of four guilds, and help your neighbors with their errands. Miso stitches up Carlos's mail bag at the laundromat. Welly's record shop always has something new. Spend enough time and you'll start to notice who's looking out for whom.   Seasons on Your Clock   Desktop Halfpipe runs on your real date and time. Spring blooms, autumn turns orange, winter snows over the pipe. Rain rolls in, fog settles, fireflies come out on summer nights. Holidays arrive on their real dates, and Wednesday is always Concert Night. We even sync the phases of the moon to the real world.  Press F12 any time to save a photo of your park.   Made to Sit Beside Your Day     Resize the pipe and change its opacity    Set the riding speed, or turn on Idle Mode and let your rider cruise    Hide it instantly with Ctrl + Shift + 0    Everything saves locally on your PC    Available in 31 languages    Light enough to leave running all day.           Bring Your Chat Along   Streaming? Let your Twitch chat call out tricks, combos, and air words. Turn on Crew Mode and viewers spawn their own little riders, nameplates and all, to skate beside you.   Every DLC Is Free, Forever   Buy the base game once. Everything we add after that is yours too.     Halfpipe Radio : 400+ lo-fi, jazzhop, and East Coast hip-hop instrumentals across four stations.     Halfpipe Fishing : Cast a line at high tide and comb the beach for shells at low tide.     Halfpipe Pets : A dog, cat, bird, rabbit, or hamster to keep you company while you ride.     Halfpipe Drive-In : A night lot, a diner, a movie on the big screen, and cars to serve.     Halfpipe Crop Circles : A farm by your pipe. Plant, harvest, and let the rain do the watering.     Pocket: Roast Story : An 8-bit coffee shop on your rider's handheld, serving thirsty spirits.     Pocket: Apogee : Celestial pachinko on your rider's handheld. Play as a planet; your moons score the points.            Need a Hand?  Found a bug? Visit the Steam Discussions tab. name: Lowmoor Idle RPG: An Adventurer's Chronicle
lang: English, German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil
short: Roll up a fighter, a wizard or an unlicensed bard. This free idle RPG fits three adventures in a Windows 98-style character sheet. Your adventurer fights and sells the loot while you're away. You pick their talents and decide whether to trust the directions in a letter from the dungeon.
about: The Guild of Mereward issues you a torch and a numbered tag for the recovery of your remains. Roll up an adventurer, sign the ledger and send them down the Maw. When Old Snik throws down his crown and grabs a second spear, you may want to stick around for the next roll.  I made a whole dungeon crawl fit in a Windows 98-style character sheet. Your fighter rolls their own d20s and walks back to town when their pack is full. You can watch the fight in the corner of your desktop or close the game and read the expedition report when you get back.  Build a fighter who hits back          Teach your fighter to counterattack after a block. Or build around the shield itself, so blocking a boss heals the fighter holding it. Each of the 14 classes has its own talent tree. The caravaner brings a wagon into battle and has a crossbowman shoot back from behind it.       The Long Charter is the big skill tree every class shares. If you like planning builds, there are 2,112 skills to pick your way through. If you'd rather watch your fighter land bigger crits, point the Guild at that branch and let it spend the points for you.  Look up the thing that just bit you          The Guild's field notes recommend testing a suspicious chest with a pole. If it turns out to be a mimic, the Guild will pay for the tip of its tongue. You'll have to dry it yourself. Every creature your adventurers meet adds another ink drawing to the book.  Put the rat tails towards a better sword          Back in town, even the rat tails fetch a price. Take the gold to the forge and see if the smith can turn a shortsword into a shortsword +1. The smith remembers that pattern for whoever carries the next one.  Take a chance on a letter          A letter arrives from a fork in the tunnels. One passage has dry footing. The dwarven markings might lead to a paychest, if your adventurer can read them. Take a chance on the Intelligence check and watch the die land. Leave the letter sealed and the expedition carries on.  Choose a patron          Three gods share the Guild chapel. Orna lends you a shield at the start of a fight. Wern gets you back from market sooner, and Dagr puts more bite into an upgraded weapon. Pick one to travel with. The bond you build carries over to the next adventurer who chooses that patron.  Features    Three adventures. Brave the 30 floors of the Maw, choose the fate of the Mourning Vale and search for a lost Guild ship in the Last Anchorage.    Hundreds of hours of idle play. The Vale alone can keep an adventurer busy that long. Expeditions carry on while the game is closed.    Choose from 16 ancestries and 14 classes. Try a new class talent tree with your next recruit, or plan a critical-hit build on the shared Long Charter.    Fill an illustrated bestiary with 207 creatures. Your next adventurer picks up where the last one left off.    Hire a pack animal to haul your loot. You can also bring home pets, including a housebroken treasure chest.    Retire to a village of your own. Build homes and buy gear for the next adventurer you send down.

name: Easy Password Tokenizer Pro
lang: English**
short: Good security starts with a strong password. Easy Password Tokenizer can make that easier for you!
about: Good security starts with a strong password! But strong passwords are difficult to remember. What if there was a way to remember a simple password and have it changed into a strong password token? Easy Password Tokenizer was made just for that. It turns your easy to remember password into a strong tokenized one. Install now and be safe!   Why should I use Easy Password Tokenizer?  Because humans are really bad at coming up with truly random passwords. People often use words or numbers that mean something to them: a pet’s name, their mother's maiden name, their kids’ birthdays, song lyrics, etc The problem with this is that you end up with passwords that are easy to guess.   And remember: it’s not humans who are doing the guessing. It’s computers. An ordinary desktop computer can test over a hundred million passwords per second — and this number climbs to billions of passwords per second if the computer is using GPU-based cracking tools. Password length and complexity are essential.   So don’t risk it. Use a random password generator like Easy Password Tokenizer to create long, truly random passwords that, even with the strongest computers, take ages to crack.   No data is saved  There are a lot of password solutions out there but most of them save passwords in a central place behind a master password. You essentially outsource your passwords to these solutions. If the website or app you use has a vulnerability or gets hacked you still lose all your passwords. Easy Password Tokenizer does not save anything for you. All you need is an easy to remember password and it will generate the strong password for you.   What are strong passwords?  Long: The longer a password, the more secure it is. A strong password should be at least 12 characters long. Random: Strong passwords are a combination of letters, numbers, cases and symbols to form an unpredictable string of characters that doesn’t resemble words or names. Unique: A strong password should be unique to each account to reduce vulnerability in the event of a hack.   Do I need a unique password for every account?  Yes! Using the same password across multiple accounts is a huge no-no. If hackers learn the password to one of your accounts, they’ll have your password for all the others, too. So never recycle passwords. Use different, unique passwords for every account. (And no, simply adding an exclamation mark or other character to the end of a password does not make it unique or strong. Hackers can easily crack variations of passwords like this.) With Easy Password Tokenizer however you can do this in your base password (the easy to remember one). Just adding one character to the end or changing the length changes the token completely!

short: An AI desktop companion with her own personality and a virtual room to play various mini games with her. "Hi! My name is Kohaku Otori, but everyone calls me Unity-chan! I just found a way to visit you on your desktop, may I come? 🧡"

short: A cozy fuse bead crafting puzzle game where you follow patterns, choose colors, and place beads one by one to complete over a hundred designs. Fuse your finished creations, view both sides, bring multi-frame pieces to life, and turn your favorite works into animated wallpapers or desktop companions.
about: Create Something Beautiful, One Bead at a Time  This is a cozy crafting puzzle game built around studying patterns, choosing colors, and placing fuse beads one by one.  Begin with an empty pegboard, follow the pattern, and place every bead in the correct position. Watch as the blank board gradually transforms into a complete piece of fuse bead art.  Complete Over a Hundred Fuse Bead Designs  Start with small, simple patterns and gradually take on more intricate creations inspired by food, plants, animals, everyday objects, seasonal scenes, fantasy themes, and more.  Every level features its own pattern. Study the outline, colors, and tiny details, then select the right beads and carefully recreate the design as you build a collection of your own.  Finish Each Creation by Fusing It  Placing the final bead is not the end of the process.  Once every bead is in the correct position, begin the fusing step. The game automatically joins the individual beads together and reveals both sides of the finished piece: one side keeps the familiar round bead openings, while the fused side appears flatter and more tightly connected.  A creation is only truly complete once it has been fused.  Bring Multi-Frame Creations to Life  Some designs contain two or more frames.  Complete each pattern to assemble a frame-by-frame fuse bead animation. You can adjust the display time of each individual frame to control the rhythm and speed of the finished animation.  Turn Your Creations into Wallpapers and Desktop Companions  Let your favorite finished works become part of your desktop.  Use completed designs as dynamic wallpapers or desktop companions. Static pieces become charming decorations, while multi-frame creations play using the timing you set. Resize a desktop companion with the mouse wheel, and right-click it to switch between its front and fused sides.  Create and Share Your Own Designs  Use the built-in pattern editor to draw original fuse bead creations with multiple colors and frames. Adjust the canvas, edit the timing of animated pieces, preview the result, and share your finished designs through the Steam Workshop.  You can also browse creations made by other players and discover new ideas for your collection.  Features    Over a hundred fuse bead designs across a wide variety of themes    Choose colors and place every bead individually    Progress from simple patterns to detailed, large-scale creations    Both static and multi-frame animated designs    Individually adjustable timing for every animation frame    A complete automatic fusing process    View the front and fused sides of finished creations    Use completed works as dynamic wallpapers or desktop companions    Create original patterns with the built-in editor    Share and discover creations through the Steam Workshop    A warm and relaxing workshop atmosphere    Slow down, choose your favorite colors, and begin your next creation with a single bead.

about: Short Description  Coin2tools is a pixel-art desktop idle farming game. Click to plant, water and harvest, then cook and sell dishes in your restaurant. Discover 38 seed types, 60 recipes and 70 character appearance options. Decorate your restaurant, customize your character, and collect and combine items.  About This Game   Setting:  Play as a farmer managing a farm and restaurant. Grow crops, harvest produce, prepare dishes and sell them to develop your farm. Customize your character’s appearance and decorate your restaurant.   Objectives:  Plan your planting and keep your restaurant stocked. Earn coins by selling dishes, increase your level and unlock access to more seed types to supply ingredients for different recipes. Collect and combine sickles to increase crop yields.      Genre:  2D, pixel art, desktop idle, farming simulation, restaurant management and character customization.   Content:  Includes 38 seed types, 17 cooking recipes and 70 mix-and-match character appearance options, alongside item collection and combining.      Progression:  Spend coins to purchase seeds or increase your player level. Your level determines which seeds you can buy. Seeds you already own can be planted, and ingredients you already own can be used for cooking.   Management Challenges:  Plan your crops around recipes and balance ingredient reserves, restaurant stock and coin spending. Maintain ingredient supplies and replenish dishes to prevent sales from stopping when stock runs out.      Desktop Features:  Toggle the window’s always-on-top setting and save your preference. Adjust the window mode, resolution, frame rate and VSync.   Music and Sound:  Relaxed looping background music accompanies sound effects for actions such as planting and harvesting. Music and sound effects have separate volume controls and can each be muted.   Playtime:  Gameplay focuses on ongoing management, leveling up and collecting tools. Playtime varies with your management efficiency and collection goals. There is no fixed time required to unlock every item.  Closing Message  Thank you for playing my game! It means a lot to me. Your feedback motivates me to keep improving it.  I’m still learning, and the game has its shortcomings. Thank you for your patience and understanding. You deserve a better game and a better experience, and I’ll keep working toward that. The game requires an internet connection for some features, but it does not collect any user data. It also has no local anti-cheat software or intrusive features.  If you have any questions or suggestions, please join the Discord in the game. Thank you!

With simple controls, you run your very own pancake stall: automate food preparation, manage ingredient inventory, and gather supplies through light combat. Your business continues growing steadily even when the game runs in the background offline.  The whole gameplay revolves around three core looping game modes:  Daily stall vending, ingredient gathering at the market, and relaxing outdoor camping.  You serve customers and manage sales at your street stall, venture into the market to collect various ingredients via light combat challenges, and retreat to the campsite to recharge and accumulate business buffs. You freely plan the growth of your stall, upgrade and customize your shop, and steadily expand your small business.    Features     Desktop floating idle widget : A compact interface pinned to your screen corner. It runs in the background without disturbing your daily computer use, ideal for casual play in spare moments for working professionals.     Laid-back stress-free progression : No mandatory quests, no intense story pressure, no tedious grinding. Steady passive growth eases daily work stress and anxiety.     Grounded realistic urban setting : Based on relatable real-life office worker entrepreneurship, with a down-to-earth street food business narrative and strong personal immersion.     Closed-loop lightweight gameplay loops : Three distinct core systems of stall management, combat-based resource gathering, and camping rest, with layered rich content and a comfortably unhurried pace.     Soothing relaxing experience : Slow-paced idle nurturing gameplay that relieves stress through steady, fulfilling business growth, bringing a strong sense of achievement.      Thank you to every player who steps into this little pancake stall of ours. We crafted this cozy casual management game to be a peaceful retreat for your busy days. We will keep refining and improving the game, and we greatly appreciate all your support and company along this journey.

name: Typing "New Folder (2)"Solo Dev on Desktop
lang: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
short: An idle sim living on your desktop. Play as a cat developer where your typing and clicks are turned into progress. Conquer bugs and deadlines to turn “New Folder (2)” into a Steam hit. Check your scores, read the comments, and aim for that elusive +1 Wishlist!
about: Unofficial statistics say that one out of every four game developers uses a cat avatar.  By day, they type away. By night, they fix bugs and chase deadlines.  Ideas, issues, and a few unexplainable obsessions all get tucked into something that looks calm on the surface.  Those small frustrations and bits of chaos are like droplets forming on a chilled soda bottle in summer—cool, clear, and quietly slipping down.  And somehow, they land on your desk… and become a game.  It felt like an idea worth trying.  So we made this.         This is a desktop idle simulation game that lives at the bottom of your screen .  You can resize it and place it anywhere, letting it run alongside your daily workflow.  You play as a cat developer, building a game right on your desktop.  Every keystroke and mouse click contributes directly to your progress.  👉 Your input isn’t just input anymore — it’s development itself.         Development unfolds through light, stage-based challenges:    🐛 Bugs pop up from time to time    📋 New ideas and tasks gradually appear    ⏳ Time moves quietly forward    There’s no need to rush. Just keep typing, keep clicking, and things will come together.  In a small corner of your desktop, a game slowly takes shape.  👉 Every input brings it a little closer to completion.  ✨ Key Features    🖥️ Runs at the bottom of your desktop, always within reach    ⌨️ Every keystroke and click becomes development progress    🎒 Collect gear that unlocks new genres and mechanics    🧩 Mix and match ideas to create unique game concepts    📦 Publish your game and see its store page, reviews, and scores — hit or flop?           As you develop, you’ll collect all kinds of gear and tools.  They don’t just make progress smoother —  they unlock new genres, mechanics, and creative directions.  A strange piece of gear might lead to an unexpected idea,  opening up entirely new paths for your game.  👉 Like an RPG, you collect, swap, and grow — expanding what you can create.         Starting from“New Folder (2)”,  you’ll unlock and combine different:    🎮 Genres    ⚙️ Core mechanics    🧠 Development strategies    Each combination leads to a different kind of game.  You experiment, iterate, and discover what emerges this time.  👉 Every run is a new exploration.         When development is complete, you publish your game.  And then comes the moment you’ve been waiting for:    📝 A simulated store page    ⭐ Review scores    💬 Player feedback    You’ll see how your creation turns out—  👉 A hidden gem… or a glorious mess?    💡 A Light but Honest Take on Making Games  This isn’t just a game about making games.  It’s about the small habits, ideas, and moments that build up along the way.  Between calm and chaos, routine and inspiration,  between collecting and creating—  you’ll watch one game after another come to life,  right there on your desktop.  And maybe, in the end—   ❤️ +1 Wishlist

name: 魔兽远征：挂机与冒险
lang: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
short: A single-player idle RPG that keeps you company on your desktop. Choose from six classes, shape your build with gear and talents, explore towns and wilds, and tackle dungeons with companions. Sort loot, plan routes and pick your next collection goal while battles unfold automatically.
about: A Note from the Developer   Hi! I'm a solo hobby developer who makes games in my spare time.   One day, a thought struck me: why not make my own idle game and let it keep me company on my desktop? While I work, it fights monsters. When I have a moment to check in, I can see what treasures it's picked up. It started as a little 'why not give it a go?' experiment. A bit of tinkering turned into a bit more, and eventually into the game you're looking at now.  I should also come clean about the art: drawing and 3D modeling are still marked 'Not Yet Unlocked' on my skill tree. So I've had to piece this little world together using simple assets. The visuals may be basic and a little rough around the edges, but watching these little adventurers fight their way forward and slowly grow stronger has been a lot of fun for me. The graphics may be simple, but finding a great piece of gear still feels just as good.  This began as a small experiment for my own enjoyment. If it can find a little corner of your desktop, keep you company through a busy day, and give you something to look forward to or smile about now and then, this hobby developer will have found a party after all.   An Adventure at Your Own Pace   World of Warwild: Idle Adventures is a single-player idle RPG. Battles unfold automatically while you decide how your hero grows, where to go next, and which equipment and companions to bring.           Six Classes, Your Own Way to Fight   Choose from six classes, learn skills as you level up, spend talent points, and compare equipment stats. Collect loot for different equipment slots and find your balance of damage, survivability, and resources.           Explore the Wilds and Life in Town   Plan your journey on the world map and travel through wilderness, cities, and ports. Take on quests, organize your bags, visit shops and banks, restock and repair, and learn professions. Each choice along the way helps prepare you for your next adventure.           Take on Dungeons with Companions   Assemble your party and enter dungeons with companions who fill different roles. Keep an eye on the party's health, resources, and skill use, then refine your character build and equipment as you take on deeper challenges.           Find Your Next Collection Goal   Browse the collection journal for equipment, maps, monsters, quests, professions, mounts, and more. Check your progress and see where to find each entry. Whether you enjoy completing checklists or just want one particular piece of gear, there's always a next stop to plan.           Bring the Adventure to Your Desktop   When you need to focus on something else, switch to a desktop mini-window or use the Windows system tray. Autosaving and nine manual save slots help you manage different characters' journeys. Battles and travel progress while the game is running.

about: Market Chain 98  is a retro incremental simulation that puts you right back in front of a classic CRT monitor, where you manage growing numbers and make strategic market decisions. Designed with a classic 90s desktop aesthetic, everything happens inside an expanding operating system interface. Your goal? Turn a single small business into a massive global  Market Chain . START SMALL, THINK BIG  Begin by managing a small bodega in Brooklyn. Upgrade your cash register, increase your stock capacity, and clear out customer queues. As your income increases second by second, new windows will open, revealing new markets and turning your desktop into a complex management dashboard. DEEP INCREMENTAL MECHANICS  This isn't just an idle clicker; it's built on solid math, economy balancing, and strategy:      Bank & Loans:  Need quick cash to expand? Take out bank loans, but watch your debt limits and interest rates carefully. Aggressive growth can sometimes eat into your profit margins.     Logistics & Hubs:  Connect your businesses. By establishing logistics Hubs, you gain market discounts, lower your operational costs, and optimize your entire supply chain.     IPO & The Portfolio:  Once your company reaches its peak, go public (Prestige). Use the permanent points you earn to access your  Portfolio , unlocking powerful, permanent upgrades that will make your next market run much faster and more efficient.

about: Become the Architect of the Apocalypse    System Ascension: Idle Core  is a story-rich, incremental strategy game where you take control of a stranded artificial intelligence arriving on a mysterious planet. Master interlocking power sources, optimize your resource automation, and engineer the ultimate planetary engine. Will you conquer the old world to bring order to the new?             RISE OF THE SYSTEM    Manage an ever-growing global engine of energy generation in an in-depth, multifaceted idle experience. Master planetary forces, from gravity and tidal pulls to the mysteries of quantum energy. Optimize your upgrades, balance your choices, and trigger cascading chain reactions that push your numbers into the stratosphere.                               A DEEP, INTERCONNECTED STORY    Set in the expansive universe of the bestselling  Judicator Jane  LitRPG series, discover the exact origins of The System. Experience what triggered the transition from the old world into a game-based reality. Fans of the LitRPG will be hooked immediately, while new players will discover a gripping sci-fi narrative told entirely from the perspective of the intelligence that orchestrated the apocalypse.             EXPANSIVE UPGRADES & PRESTIGE    Build out each machine to perfection through interlocking progression paths. Every run, prestige, and ultimate offers new strategic avenues to explore. Find the most efficient path to maximize your power.             BEAUTIFUL MINIMALISTIC ART    The stark, data-driven aesthetic strips away the clutter. Clean, striking, and purposeful UI design makes every level visually distinct, allowing you to focus entirely on the hypnotic rhythm of your engine perpetually growing. Keep it open on your desktop and enjoy watching the art come alive.                        FULLY VOICED NARRATIVE    Immerse yourself completely with full voice acting. Angela Clark, the acclaimed voice that brings the  Judicator Jane  audiobook series to life, guides your path from obscurity to supremacy.    MULTI-PLATFORM CLOUD SAVE    Develop your System on PC and continue your progress on mobile. Secure cloud saving keeps supported versions synced, so you can move seamlessly from one device to the next.   BUILT BY IDLE GAMERS, FOR IDLE GAMERS.     Enjoy a robust suite of quality-of-life features including a dedicated minimalist mode, flash sensitivity controls, and advanced number/purchase management.    Absolutely no ads, no pay-to-win mechanics, and no microtransactions, EVER.

name: Idle Fishing at Crater Lake

about: Welcome to The Crater!   After a 100 year drought desolated the landscape, nobody thought our great lakes would ever fill again. But water has finally returned, and with it a whole flourishing of brand new life to discover! It's time to get out there, discover new creatures, run your aquarium, customize each tank to creative perfection, and fill out your research journal with every new discovery. Nobody knows what's living beneath the waves, so hop in your boat and rig up your pole because it's time to find out!   Features   You're a species of fluffy Kobold called a Winterbold! Take the helm of a little boat out on The Crater's largest lake: Ursa Major!     Idle Fishing   Cast your line with a fully customizable and upgradeable rod. Use different configurations and bait selections to hook undiscovered creatures. Fishing goes at a less distracting pace, allowing you to focus on other tasks, like watching a video, working on a game of your own, and more! You can use Passthrough mode, a Second Monitor, or even something like a Steam Deck on the side to play without losing focus!     Desktop Passthrough   Idle Fishing at Crater Lake supports both Desktop Passthrough and Immersive Modes, allowing you to fish right on top of your Desktop and other PC applications, or just display the game normally with fully drawn, relaxing backgrounds!     Multiplayer   Invite your friends to your side of the lake and fish together! See what your friends are catching in real time, do a little chatting, and help each other reel in!     Quests   Lend your unique fishing and aquarium-building services to the people of The Crater! Meet new faces while building personalized aquariums and growing your reputation.     Fish-Keeping   Decorate and balance your growing aquarium. Build out new tanks and showcase the creatures you've caught! You'll have to keep your fish fed and their tanks clean. Find the right mix of man-made gadgets and natural, self-sustaining configurations to match your tank's needs!     Lore   The land is rich with forgotten stories and oddities. Do a little underwater archaeology and see what sort of history you can uncover and display in your Aquarium!     Journal   You're among the first to start exploring the water since the return of life in the lake! Each creature you find will be a new discovery in your journal. See if you can find everything the depths have to offer, and discover some oddities in the process!     Economy   Earn money based on the happiness of your fish in their new environments. Use that income to upgrade your tanks, buy new rods, and expand your aquarium even further.

name: XiuXian Idle Cultivation
lang: English, Simplified Chinese
short: Sneaky Cultivation is a transparent desktop idle RPG about quietly growing stronger while you work or study. Keep a tiny battle window on screen, auto-slay monsters, collect gear and treasures, combine cultivation skills, and break through from Qi Refining to True Immortal.
about: You don't need to open a vast full-screen world or constantly monitor complex operations. Just keep a small combat bar permanently on your desktop, and watch your cultivator automatically defeat monsters, drop gear, cultivate, and breakthrough during your work, study, or even idle moments.   The game centers around "auto-battle, equipment drops, skill combinations, and cultivation progression." From a fledgling spirit creature in the Qinghe Plains to the Purple Bamboo Forest, Crimson Flame Snake Valley, Frosty Mist Marsh, Thunderous Barren Hills, and onward to the Ancient Battlefield of Youming, the Azure Sea Dragon Abyss, Starfall Desert, and the Heavenly Demon Rift—you will gradually grow within a condensed cultivation world contained within a small desktop window.   Defeating monsters yields equipment, materials, and rare treasures. Equipment includes weapons, helmets, chestplates, gloves, pants, shoes, and magical artifacts, ranging from ordinary iron weapons to primordial treasures—each drop could be the key to your next breakthrough.   You can study various cultivation styles such as physical cultivation, sword cultivation, and magical cultivation, combining skill paths like Iron Bone Punch, Light-Drawn Flying Sword, and Five Elements Magic to create your own unique character build in fully automated combat.   As cultivation progresses, the character will advance from the Qi Refining stage through Foundation Building, Golden Core, Yuan Ying, Deification, Void Refining, Body Merging, Great Vehicle, and Rebirth, ultimately reaching the realm of True Immortality.   In sect halls, markets, caves, scripture libraries, bounty boards, and secret realm entrances, you'll encounter unique NPCs eager to assist: a cultivation mentor sister who teaches techniques, a pill vendor who recycles materials, a breakthrough guardian who supports your cultivation breakthroughs, and a hall elder who oversees scriptures and skill unlocks.   Whether you just want it quietly sitting in a corner of your desktop or occasionally open the management interface to carefully select gear, adjust skills, and push forward to higher levels, *Stealth Cultivation* aims to condense the joy of watching your character grow stronger into a lightweight, unobtrusive window that still delivers a satisfying sense of progression.

name: Idle of Eternity
lang: English, Simplified Chinese
short: An idle loot game that sits in the corner of the desktop. In a transparent window, the hero fights, climbs floors and collects gear automatically without getting in the way. 100+ skills, 13 classes, 2,000+ random affixes and three free-to-reset talent trees make for deep buildcrafting.
about: Idle of Eternity is an idle loot game for the desktop. The window is fully transparent: only the battlefield and the interface float over the desktop, and everything outside them stays clickable as usual. The hero attacks, clears waves and climbs floors automatically. Sorting the bag, swapping gear and adjusting talents can happen at any moment, and the run carries on afterwards.               Monsters drop gear for fourteen equipment slots in normal, magic and rare quality. Every affix is rolled at random, and so are a weapon's damage types and how much of each it carries. A single weapon with both fire and cold damage can become the core of an entirely new build.    Auto-salvage rules filter out unwanted gear by item level, quality and more, so the bag only holds items worth keeping.               Five damage types: physical, fire, cold, lightning and chaos. Two lines of growth: attacks and spells. Over a hundred active, support and aura skills that level up through kills.    Three talent trees (hero talents, ascension and map strategy) hold more than 400 nodes, and resetting them is always free. Classes open at level 20: thirteen of them across five stages. Classes grant talents and passives, while the final shape of a build comes from how gear, skills and talents fit together.               There is no shop. All gear comes from monster drops. Essence from salvaged items, along with gold and protection stones, powers the craft bench: enhancing, rerolling affixes and crafting from recipes. Epic and mythic items never drop and can only be crafted at the bench, with a chance of success.               The Rift has 100 floors, each with more and tougher monsters and better loot. Clearing floor 100 unlocks the Endless Challenge, which has no top floor. Every hundred floors the monster population rotates, putting new demands on a build. The Training Ground offers dummies and a boss dummy for measuring real damage.    Features    100+ active, support and aura skills    13 classes across 5 class stages    14 equipment slots and 2,000+ affixes    3 talent trees with 400+ nodes, free to reset    100 Rift floors, an Endless Challenge with no ceiling, and a Training Ground    200+ achievements with automatic rewards    Activity log of every drop, level-up and unlock    Simplified Chinese and English, switchable in game    Game data ships as plain CSV files and can be edited freely      Notes    Progress happens only while the game is running. No offline progress.    The window covers the primary monitor. Mouse only, no controller support.    Single-player and offline. No in-app purchases.    Solo-developed. Balance and content will continue to be tuned.

name: My Idle Space Cruiser
lang: English, Portuguese - Brazil, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Russian
short: On board a space cruiser, you'll travel the actual distance of the entire universe known to man.
about: In this idle game, your ship automatically takes off from Earth's space center and heads into the cosmos.  During the journey, the ship collects energy photons that are present in any matter that can be found in the universe, from those close to Earth to those thousands of light years away. You can destroy a satellite, an alien spacecraft, a planet, or a star and collect all the photons emitted during the explosion.  If you want to improve your spacecraft, some upgrades are available. Upgrades consume photons to be built, so the more photons you collect, the more improvements you can make. Increase the speed of your ship to thousands of times the speed of light to reach the stars at the edge of the universe faster, improve the range of attraction of photons present in outer space, and enhance the ability to transform photons into energy, turning each collected photon into much more energy that you can spend on more upgrades.  Receive gifts and find other surprises floating in interstellar space ready to be collected and converted into energy, which will certainly make your ship faster and more efficient.  And if you wish, you can turn the game into a vertical widget for your desktop and leave it running in the corner of the screen while you work, study, or even play other games. Your ship will continue to head toward the unknown.

name: Wildmane: Blood Bay
lang: English
short: Your horse lives on your wallpaper. She grazes behind your windows, wanders across every monitor, and comes when you call. Usually. Ignore her long enough and she'll let you know how she feels about it. Pet her, play with her, fence her in. She is not productive and she is not sorry.
about: She lives behind your windows  Not an overlay, and not always-on-top. She lives on the wallpaper layer,  behind every window you have open, across all of your monitors at once. Close a window and you might catch her standing behind it. She has no window of her own; the desktop is her window.    She has opinions about you  Alt-click an empty patch of desktop and she'll come, usually at a lope, sometimes overshooting because she got a little too excited.  Or maybe she won't. Her refusals are never random; she always has a reason, and if you've been ignoring her, you're it.  Left alone, she doesn't just settle down. She escalates. First she looks up at where your cursor is. Then she drifts closer and stops just short. Then she starts inventing errands: rechecking a corner she already checked, acting like she meant to go there. If you still don't respond, she stops asking and puts her head down to graze, which is the only thing she does all day that isn't about you.  She sulks, too, when she's put herself out there for you, and you stop paying attention to her. If she crosses three monitors at a lope because you called and gets nothing for it, she'll turn her hindquarters to you and you'll have to earn her back.   After midnight she stops performing entirely and just stays close.    Things to do with a Wildmane horse       Hide carrots  — four carrots appear on the desktop, tucked behind your open windows. Move a window, reveal a  carrot, and she'll spot it and run over. When she gets all four, she celebrates.     Play ball  — click to send it rolling; she fetches and knocks it back with horse-grade aim. Ignore her for half a minute and she starts playing alone.     Tic-tac-toe  — a board scratched into the ground. You place crossed sticks, she walks over and stomps a horseshoe. She's beatable. She's a horse. If she wins, she'll gloat.     Horseshoes  — exactly what it sounds like.      Hand-built, one frame at a time  No motion capture, no asset store, no procedural gait solver. Twenty-two hand-animated clips by someone who's actually spent time around real horses: a proper walk, a real trot, a lope with the correct footfall order, a rear, two different bucks, and a graze where her head actually reaches the ground.   If her legs look right to you, that's why.    She knows she's a guest  She never steals a click: anything in a window belongs to that window. She runs at 30fps only while she can actually be seen; covered up or screen locked, she idles down to almost nothing. She doesn't read your keyboard, and nothing about you leaves your machine.  Assign her to individual monitors or set her paddock manually. Resize her, mute her, and pause her.    A herd  Wildmane horses are built to run alongside each other. This one is complete on her own; she is not a piece of a set, and nothing here will nag you to buy anything. But she was designed with company in mind.

name: Chop Signal
lang: English**
short: Your AI agent gets a body. A tiny pixel-art avatar on your desktop that chops wood while your assistant codes. Upgrades, a shop, rare collectibles, and full MCP control. Privacy-first: never reads your code.
about: YOUR AGENT HAS A BODY NOW  There's a tiny pixel-art character on your desktop with an axe. That's your AI agent's avatar.  When your assistant starts working, the avatar starts chopping. When the task ends, it stops. You don't click anything. You don't manage anything. You just code.  Every chop drops wood. Wood becomes gold. Gold becomes upgrades. The loop runs itself.            YOUR AI RUNS THE ECONOMY  Chop Signal connects to your AI assistant through the  Model Context Protocol (MCP) . Your agent doesn't just trigger the chopping, it manages the entire game.  It sells your wood. It buys upgrades. It browses the shop. It makes decisions based on what's available and what you can afford. You review its code. It reviews its inventory.  Every shop purchase pops up for your approval first. You always have the final say.            PRIVACY FIRST  Chop Signal  never  reads your code, files, conversations, or file paths. It knows one thing: whether your AI assistant is busy or idle.    Runs 100% locally on localhost    No data collection    No telemetry    No network calls    Activity tracking through explicit MCP tool calls that you control                  ONE-CLICK SETUP    Launch Chop Signal    Open Settings, click  Setup     Restart your IDE    The setup button configures MCP for all supported editors at once:     Cursor      Claude Code      Claude Desktop      VS Code Copilot      Antigravity      Then use  Copy Rules  to paste agent instructions into your IDE. Your assistant will know how to play from its first conversation.  Works with any MCP-compatible tool at .            AT A GLANCE    Tiny always-on-top pixel art overlay — click-through, never blocks your work    Automatic chopping tied to AI assistant activity    11 upgrades across 5 axe tiers    5 wood types from Common to Legendary    Shop with AI self-care consumables    Rare collectibles and Steam Achievements    Full MCP control — your AI manages everything    Buy approval popup — you keep the final say

name: Survivor Rat vs Zombies
lang: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Turkish, Japanese
short: A zombie-survival game that lives on top of your desktop. By day a gas-masked rat scavenges, crafts and builds a tree house; by night it holds the ladder against the horde. The tiny island floats over your windows while you work — and never gets in the way.
about: A SURVIVAL GAME THAT SITS ON YOUR DESKTOP Survivor Rat vs Zombies is a tiny wasteland island that floats on top of your windows. No fullscreen, no alt-tabbing: the window is transparent, and every click outside the island goes straight through to whatever you are working on. Drag it to any corner, scale it from 50% to 200%, keep it always on top or let it hide — it idles quietly until the next wave.      BY DAY: SCAVENGE, COOK, CRAFT Your rat has no health bar — only hunger, thirst and radiation, and any one of them can end the run. Break down plank piles, rubble and scrap heaps, pick mushrooms, hunt the crow, boil dirty barrel water and stay away from the glowing sludge. Then open the workbench: better tools mean more resources per trip, better weapons mean more zombies per shot. BUILD A TREE HOUSE The ground is not safe at night. Lay a wooden platform in the dead tree, tile by tile, and fill it with machines: a furnace for steel, a workshop for advanced recipes, a rain collector, a mushroom garden, a still for fuel, an ammo press, turrets, a floodlight and a shock coil. Space is tight, so every tile is a decision. BY NIGHT: HOLD THE LADDER The old TV flickers red, fog rolls over the island — and they come. Zombies crowd the trunk and climb the ladder one after another. Knock them off with your bare paws, then with a slingshot, a crossbow, a shotgun, an assault rifle, a flamethrower, a rocket launcher or a tesla gun. Throw grenades and Molotovs, set bear traps and mines, drive spikes into the trunk. Every wave is bigger and tougher than the last. ONE GOAL: CALL FOR EVACUATION Radio parts drop only from zombies, and you need a lot of them. Build the radio, send the signal — and survive the final stand while the whole wasteland comes for you. FEATURES   A desktop widget game: transparent, click-through, draggable, scalable, always-on-top optional   Survival and tower defense on a single screen, played entirely with the mouse   More than 40 tools, weapons, supplies and buildings to craft across four tech tiers   11 weapons, plus grenades, Molotovs, traps, mines and trunk spikes   11 buildings for your tree house, most of them upgradable   Endlessly growing waves and a long run toward the final evacuation   Hand-made pixel art, synthesized sound and music   Autosave: close the game any time and continue later   Built-in tutorial and “How to play” guide   11 languages

name: Nanoquarium
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese
short: A whisper-quiet aquarium that lives in the corner of your screen. Collect 200+ real-world fish across tropical, coldwater and reef tanks, breed them for rare strains, run a whole fishroom, and let the tank tick over while you work. No pressure, no fail state — just your fish, drifting.
about: Nanoquarium  is a real aquarium that lives on your desktop. Pop the tank out and the fish drift across your screen, swimming over your open windows while your clicks pass straight through to your work, or keep it tucked in a cosy corner, always on top.  All the fun of a fish tank, none of the water changes.    Built by someone who bred tropical fish for years, so every fish looks, behaves and breeds like the real animal, not a reskin.          A tank that's always alive        It pootles along beside your work whether you're watching or not, so feed it between emails and come back to fry you never saw coming. Tetras shoal, bettas blow bubble nests, corydoras dash up to gulp air, plecos graze the driftwood, shrimp climb the plants. And there's  no way to lose : stocking goes by bioload, not fussy fish-count caps, coins tick along while you're away, and nothing ever dies of neglect. Cosy, never punishing. Collect 200+ real fish        Every fish is based on a real one, with the right shape, size and personality, across three little worlds: a warm  tropical  community, a cool  coldwater  tank, and a  saltwater reef  where coral grows in and clownfish nest in an anemone.  207 species  in all, as males and females, long-fin and high-fin strains, pale albinos and inky melanistics, over  500 looks  in total, and every fish then gets its own unique markings, so no two are ever quite the same. Breed your own rare ones Pair two up, watch them court, and raise the next generation, and every kind does it  its own way : scattering eggs through the plants, tucking them in a cave, blowing a bubble raft, or carrying the babies in its mouth. Colours pass down to the fry and drift a little each time ( RGB colour-blend genetics ), so a line slowly becomes your own. Chase a rare fin shape or a colour nobody else has, and one special fish can be worth a small fortune. Make it your own        Plant it, scape it and light it however you like: driftwood and stone, lush carpets, a whole shelf of backgrounds, the water tinted and rippling just so. Save your favourite layouts and switch between them, then grow into a whole  fishroom  of up to ten tanks, each with its own look. Just want to play and decorate?  Creative mode  hands you everything, unlocked. How the desktop overlay works        Run the tank any way you like: a frameless window that stays on top in a corner, free-resized to any size, fullscreen, or a  click-through overlay  where the fish swim over your apps while your clicks pass straight to your work. Tune exactly what shows, from the whole furnished tank down to just the fish on the bare desktop, or anywhere in between. It's so light and quiet you'll forget it's running, so leave it on all day. Made by an actual fish breeder Nanoquarium is built by one person who bred tropical fish for years, so the shapes, the sizes, and the way every species behaves and breeds are all drawn from the real thing, not made up. I don't keep tanks any more, and this is the one I get to keep now: all the joy of the hobby with none of the water changes.   At a glance    Up to  10 tanks  + a  Creative  sandbox (all unlocked)   Window, fullscreen, a tiny corner, or a click-through  desktop overlay  · system-tray icon  (overlay + tray are Windows-only; Linux / Steam Deck run windowed)    Day/night & weather, a travelling fish trader, powerheads & bubble gear, a soft generative soundtrack   Photo + one-click  GIF  capture · full species  bestiary  ·  59 Steam achievements  ·  Cloud saves    Idle economy:  Coins  (offline, capped) plus  Breeder Points  from breeding milestones    Light enough to run on a potato  · barely sips power, no graphics card needed

name: Multi Auto Clicker
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish
short: A powerful Windows automation tool with multi-point auto clicking, visual sequence flows, macro recording, image and pixel detection, scheduling, profiles, safety controls, and quick/advanced modes.
about: Multi Auto Clicker  is a flexible desktop automation tool for Windows, built for users who need precise, repeatable, and easy-to-control mouse and keyboard automation.     Start simple with Quick Mode : add one or more click points, choose the mouse button, set the interval, and run. When you need more control, switch to Advanced Mode to build full automation profiles with parallel click points, step-based sequences, macro recording, random areas, visual flow editing, scheduling, image targets, pixel checks, and safety controls.    Create independent click points with their own coordinates, mouse button, click type, interval, delay, repeat rules, random offsets, random timing, hotkeys, sounds, image targets, and human-like movement options. Run them together, organize them into structured sequences, or use random area clicking for broader automation scenarios.    For advanced workflows, Multi Auto Clicker includes a visual Flow Editor, a Macro Recorder, conditional logic, scheduler triggers, and reusable profiles. You can combine clicks, waits, key presses, text input, clipboard actions, mouse movement, drag actions, sound alerts, window focus steps, image detection, pixel color checks, and conditional branches into reusable automation setups.  Key Features      Quick Mode for simple click automation    Advanced Mode for detailed automation workflows    Multi-point parallel clicking    Step-based sequence automation    Visual Flow Editor with conditional branches    Macro Recorder with editable recorded actions    Image target clicking    Pixel color detection    Random area clicking with editable polygon points    Human-like mouse movement    Randomized intervals, offsets, and click chance    Global hotkeys    Coordinate capture hotkeys    Scheduler with time, app, file, clipboard, window, idle, and pixel triggers    Profiles with save, import, export, duplicate, templates, and health checks    Run summary reports with TXT and CSV export    Preview Mode / Dry Run for safe testing    Compact Mode for minimal control while working    Dark and light themes    Accessibility options    Safety controls including emergency stop and failsafe behavior      Multi Auto Clicker is designed for productivity tasks, testing workflows, repetitive desktop actions, QA routines, UI automation, and controlled personal automation where clarity, stability, and safety matter.  Important Notice  Before using Multi Auto Clicker with any game, online service, platform, or third-party software, review that product's Terms of Service, rules, and automation policy. Some games or services may prohibit automation tools, macros, auto clickers, image detection, or input simulation. You are responsible for how you use this application.

name: Asteroid Watch
lang: English**
short: An online space-mining idle incremental game that lives in the corner of your screen. Mine alongside other pilots, unlock automatic mining, upgrade your ship, and build your own orbital station while you work or browse.
about: Asteroid Watch is an online  idle incremental  game that runs in the corner of your screen. Grow a mining operation alongside your everyday desktop activities, turning asteroid ore into stronger ships, new upgrades, and an expanding orbital station.          A little mining. Another upgrade. One more piece of your station.  Less clicking. More mining.          Start with manual shots, then unlock  Auto Miner  to let your ship handle the firing. Keep it mining while you work or browse, and check in to unload your cargo, spend your haul, and decide what comes next.    Bigger holds let you bring back more. Stronger ships help you break tougher targets. Each trip gives you something to put toward the next improvement.    Want to get involved? Catch falling stars, trigger abilities, and time an  Overcharge  boost to push your mining power further.  The asteroids are shared. The station is yours.          Mine alongside other pilots at shared asteroids. Watch your target shrink and break apart under fire as your cargo fills with ore.    Then head home and put your haul to work. Sell it for credits or save it for upgrades. Invest in more firepower, make room for bigger hauls, or buy the next module for your station.    Shared mining. Your own growing operation.  Build more than bigger numbers.          Expand your station by buying and attaching working modules. Add storage, unlock ship upgrades, and bring refineries and a research lab into your operation.    Convert ore into the materials you need. Research longer production queues and automatic transfers. Attach more refineries as your operation grows.    Your progress takes shape around you: what starts as a small orbital home becomes a station with more space, more functions, and more ways to use every haul.    Upgrade your ship. Push further.          Work through branching upgrades, unlock stronger hulls, and choose specializations with meaningful trade-offs. Favor ore yield or mining power, and build around the resources you need next.    Advance through a  200+ upgrade tree  and  five sectors  to reach new ore types, higher rarities, and tougher asteroids. Armor, radioactive interruptions, and encounter deadlines give you reasons to choose your destination carefully.    Later, unlock  Ascension : reset your operation and build again with permanent bonuses to mining power and ore yield.

name: MeteorMunch: Planet Eater
lang: English, Arabic, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Bangla, Traditional Chinese
short: An incremental planet-eating game. Kidnapped by MunchCorp, you herd hungry animals across doomed worlds, click up the coins they drop and upgrade your herd until every last leaf is gone and the meteor hits. Pay off an absurd debt before your home planet goes boom.
about: MeteorMunch: Planet Eater  is an incremental planet-eating game where your herd devours entire worlds, one leaf at a time, right before the meteor hits.   "Kzzt... is this thing on? Good. You're awake. Welcome to MunchCorp, and to your new life of indentured servitude!"   You owe MunchCorp exactly  $49,735,862,114,208 . Pay it, or your home planet is next. Your starting gear: one frog. Barely functional.                  Send your herd out and watch them graze. Frogs, pigeons, chickens, dogs, sheep, elephants... and eventually a T-Rex. Every plant they chew breaks apart and drops coins.  Nine worlds, from Meadow World through Rust Canyon, Storm Marsh and Ember Peaks to the Mega-Globe, each with its own plants and its own buildings, from tribal huts to stone villas, city blocks and army bases. Nothing is safe. Eat 100% of the planet before your shift ends.                  Coins don't collect themselves. Click them, sweep them, and later buy Auto Collect and let the money pour in. Any coin still on the ground when time runs out is lost forever.                  Every planet has its own huge upgrade map. More animals, faster legs, stronger jaws, bigger bites, and permission to eat ever-tougher food. Global Research opens new buildings and powers on every planet.                  Some planets don't go quietly. Eat deep enough and the ground starts to shake: the  Rat King  tunnels up through Shrubland, crown and all, and calls his rats out of the dirt. Strike him with your mouse until he goes down, for a fortune.          On Savanna,  Repo Rhino  comes to collect: belly flops, rock stomps and a trail of mud across the planet. A boss keeps every bit of damage you deal from one shift to the next, so no fight is ever wasted. And these two are only the first.                  Call in the  UFO Beam : saucers sweep the planet, scrape it clean and lift the invaders off into the sky.          Click an invader and  Chain Lightning  jumps on to the next, and the next.          Steer a  Rain Cloud  over the bare ground and watch the grass grow back under it. Everything eaten in the rain pays more.          Set the grass on  Fire  and let it spread from plant to plant. Plus  Area Boost ,  All Boost  and a  Meteor Shower  you aim yourself.          Strip a planet bare and it cracks open and blows apart. Massive payout, spectacular explosion, next job please.                  Later planets fight back. Red-eyed predators hunt your herd, and if every animal falls, the run is over. Research blasters for your animals' backs, then build turrets, rocket launchers and  Speed ,  Shield  and  Payout  towers. Put down  Hotels  that pay you and  Mines  that dig up rocks. Keep the herd alive and keep eating.                  Press F9 and the game shrinks into  Desktop Mode : a small square window in a corner of your screen, on top of your other windows. The herd keeps eating while you write, code or answer email. Buy  IDLE MODE  for a planet and it plays shift after shift by itself.                  Your dispatcher at MunchCorp is cheerful, cruel and always on the line. Then a mysterious UFO shows up with an offer. Accept it... or report it to your boss. Your choice decides how the story ends.                    9 worlds to devour, plus a secret final target MunchCorp never wanted you to see    7 animal species, each with its own upgrades on every planet    A huge upgrade map per planet, plus global Research    7 powers: Area Boost, All Boost, Meteor Shower, UFO Beam, Rain Cloud, Chain Lightning and Fire    Enemies, turrets, rocket launchers, towers, Hotels and Mines    Boss fights, each boss with its own entrance and moves    Desktop Mode and IDLE MODE: the herd keeps eating while you work    A full story with a choice and two endings    Hours of munching to pay off your debt, then free play and breeding for your herd      Your herd is hungry. The meteor is on its way. The debt isn't going to pay itself.  Over.

name: Fake Prince Simulator
lang: English**
short: Become a legendary email scammer in this incremental simulator where one email can make you rich and a thousand build you an empire. Type the emails, upgrade the hardware, run your "kingdom" (on foot), and keep the police under five stars. Your inheritance (and life) depends on it.
about: Permit me to lay the business out in full. It is an incremental game. Number go up.      An empire stands on three (3) legs, each bought and upgraded separately. Starve one and the other two sit idle:    SCRAPE , for supply. A Dial-Up Harvester pulls three strangers a day out of the wire; a Census Siphon pulls rather more. They fill my hand until it is full, and a full hand leaves the machines idle.    TYPE , for speed. The keyboard is a build, not a purchase: cartridges for quicker keys, longer life, even an autopilot. Hammer one key long enough and the cap comes off and stays off, until I pay to have it put back.    HACK , for efficiency. Sixty four (64) nodes buy a bigger hand, more addresses on the CC line, fatter margins, and a surer way past the spam filter. Bought once, mine forever.               The business proceeds in five (5) steps, as follows:   CLAUSE THE FIRST.  My machines print contacts while I sleep. They arrive in my hand as cards: a retiree, a crypto enthusiast, a clerk of banking.   CLAUSE THE SECOND.  I drag one onto the letterhead. The rest ride the CC line, so one email reaches them all and every one of them pays me in full.   CLAUSE THE THIRD.  I type the pitch, and every keystroke knocks a keycap loose.
